On February 5, 2019, Apple Inc. announced that Angela Ahrendts, Senior Vice President, Retail, will depart effective April 15, 2019. Deirdre O’Brien assumed the role of Senior Vice President, Retail + People, on February 5, 2019.

The NTSC and CSA are partnering to improve vendor security by standardizing cloud security reviews through the CSA's Security, Trust & Assurance Registry (STAR). The organizations will collaborate on a STAR-based questionnaire, a joint whitepaper, research, and industry events to help CISOs more effectively vet cloud security vendors.

Consumer Electricals Ltd (CGCEL) submitted an expression of interest on September 20, 2017, to bid for the business and brand of Kenstar, a subsidiary of the debt-laden Videocon group. The bid price was not disclosed, and no negotiations or binding documents have been executed.

Founded in 2007, HydroChic is a New Rochelle, N.Y., athletic clothing company started by Daniella Teutsch and Sara Wolf. Originally intended to provide modest swimwear, the business expanded to serve women with special health needs, such as those requiring mastectomy support or skin protection. The founders, former educators, transitioned to entrepreneurship to offer more flattering and functional garment options.

Legal experts predict higher education will be a frequent subject for the Supreme Court this term. While only two college-related cases concerning transgender rights are on the main docket, the "shadow docket" allows for rapid, interim decisions without traditional processes. Experts note that shadow docket rulings have already impacted higher education by allowing administration policies to proceed before full analysis. Future legal challenges are expected to involve First Amendment rights, visa policies, academic freedom, and federal funding.
The Riley Oil Company in Paoli, Indiana, is a family-operated full-service gas station that has provided free gas pumping and windshield washing since 1971.

52-year-old Zette Madden was arrested after allegedly threatening Oklahoma City Taco Bell employees with a tire iron, demanding money, and causing thousands of dollars in property damage. After Madden ignored commands to drop the weapon, an officer used a taser to detain her. She faces charges of robbery and malicious injury and destruction of property.

This study uses molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the temperature-dependent nanoindentation response of single-crystalline $\alpha$-titanium in [0001], [10$\bar{1}$0], and [2$\bar{1}$10] orientations at 10 K, 300 K, and 600 K. Results show that crystallographic orientation and temperature significantly influence load-displacement curves, dislocation activity, and surface morphology. Basal a-type dislocations are the dominant carriers of plasticity, while pyramidal $\langle c+a \rangle$ slip increases with temperature. The [0001] orientation exhibits the highest dislocation density and most pronounced pop-in events, whereas prismatic orientations show lower dislocation densities due to enhanced thermal recovery. The study links Schmid factor mapping and shear strain to observed surface features, such as the circular pile-up in [0001] and the dual-lobe morphology in [10$\bar{1}$0].
On June 2, 2022, Microsoft Corporation updated its guidance for the quarter ending June 30, 2022, due to unfavorable foreign exchange rate movement.

Falkland Islands Senior Fisheries Scientist Alexander Arkhipkin warns that unregulated high seas fishing, where management organizations are absent, limits data on vessel numbers and catch amounts. This lack of information constrains stock assessments for species shared between the high seas and EEZs, increasing overfishing risks. Arkhipkin recently participated in an international workshop in Peru to advise on improving jumbo squid stock assessment methods and addressing the impact of high seas fishing.

This disclosure relates to physical layer preambles and signaling for wireless communication, specifically for new protocols like IEEE 802.11be. A method for wireless communication involves receiving a packet with a preamble portion containing a universal signal field (U-SIG) followed by version-specific signal fields, such as an Extremely High Throughput signal field (EHT-SIG). The U-SIG includes version-independent and version-dependent fields, such as a version identifier, frequency occupation information (bandwidth and punctured channel indicators), and a format information field used to determine the packet format. The EHT-SIG may include resource unit (RU) allocation, spatial stream configuration, and per-user signaling. The disclosure also describes preamble designs that accommodate parallelization across subchannels and support various PPDU formats, including trigger-based (TB), single-user (SU), and multi-user (MU) communications.
Nintendo confirmed that its Labo line will include Toy Con Garage, a workshop for building custom cardboard creations using basic inputs and actions.

After winning a controversial unanimous decision against Stephen Thompson at UFC Fight Night 130 in Liverpool, Darren Till offered to rematch Thompson in America as soon as possible to address critics of the decision.

The Department of Justice has called for an investigation into the University of Nevada at Reno’s UndocuPack program to determine if taxpayer funds are being used to assist undocumented students. UNR President Brian Sandoval defended the program, stating it uses no federal funds and complies with all laws. Advocates worry this move is part of an administration effort to intimidate universities and may cause institutions to scale back or close support services for undocumented students.

The invention relates to processing mobile payments when disconnected from payment servers. A computer-implemented method and system facilitate offline transactions by allowing a user device to receive offline payment requests from a merchant payment system via a local communications connection. The user device provides a payment approval message to the merchant system and later provides offline transaction information to a payment server once network connectivity is restored. To prevent overdrawing accounts, an offline mode is enabled for only one user device associated with an e-wallet at a time, and this mode can be transferred between user devices. The payment server utilizes an offline status repository to manage enablement and a transaction ID system to prevent duplicate processing of the same transaction.

The High Post Offense utilizes a 2-3 player alignment featuring high post splits, down screens, and back cuts to create scoring opportunities for all five players. The system relies on defensive recognition to execute various reads and counters, such as curls, fades, and slips. Key phases include high post splits, down screens, high post isolation, and strong post-ups. Variations like wing pass and double away entries allow for personnel-specific adaptations, while the offense emphasizes spacing, coordination, and offensive rebounding.

The disclosed tonneau cover for pickup trucks comprises a base panel and multiple movable panel sections. Each panel section features a latching assembly consisting of two pinch latch assemblies—one on each side—connected by a longitudinally extending connector. This configuration allows an operator to unlatch both sides of a panel section by actuating a single pinch handle. The pinch latch assemblies include a latch handle portion with a spring-loaded latch and an inner pinch handle portion. Additional features include a vertical support gusset assembly to hold panels upright, a hinge assembly with a seal and spacer, side rails with clips, and a buckle securement system.

Bank of England executive director Vicky Saporta stated that major changes to bank capital or liquidity requirements are unlikely following the implementation of Basel III reforms. Future regulatory focus will shift toward new risks, such as cyber-attack resilience and the unintended consequences of existing leverage rules.

After suffering an elbow injury in late July, Yankees outfielder Aaron Judge is unsure if he will require surgery. While the injury impacted his arm strength, it did not affect his hitting performance.

Microsoft is a technology company that develops and supports software, services, devices, and solutions. Its business is organized into three operating segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The company focuses on three interconnected ambitions: reinventing productivity and business processes, building the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform, and creating more personal computing. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and organization on the planet to achieve more.

The disclosure describes methods and apparatus for manufacturing multi-chip modules (MCM), such as multi-die integrated fan-out (InFO) packages, to support high-performance computing applications. The process involves arranging tested interconnect structures on a carrier substrate, encapsulating them in a first encapsulant to form a reconstructed wafer, and bonding packaged semiconductor devices to the interconnect structures via Cu-to-Cu or solder bonding. A second encapsulant is then used to encase the semiconductor dies. The resulting large-scale components utilize redistribution layers and can feature a single universal interconnect structure to bridge adjacent components, improving reliability and performance for high data rate requirements.

On November 26, 2001, Enron Corp. shares fell to an all-time low amid intensifying doubts regarding its proposed acquisition by Dynegy Inc. Investors expressed concern that Dynegy might invoke "material adverse change" clauses to cancel or restructure the deal due to Enron's deteriorating financial state. Enron recently formalized a three-week extension on a $690 million debt payment to December 14. Additionally, Enron faces multiple class-action lawsuits from employees seeking $850 million over lost 401(k) retirement savings.

Martin Colin Hodder, 45, was jailed for 18 months at Stockport magistrates’ court after admitting to two charges of assault. In January, while intoxicated, Hodder attacked his ex-partner and her daughter with a butter knife, causing injuries to the women.

Coach Julien addressed various topics, including an injury evaluation for a player, team performance, and defensive awareness. He discussed the importance of depth and secondary scoring, noting that role players must contribute. Regarding player Zdeno, he defended the defenseman's performance and character. Additionally, he touched on coaching strategies, such as managing the bench, line changes, and the challenges of playing in a tight playoff series.

The February 20, 2002, edition of Enerfax Daily provides natural gas and power market data, including physical prices, futures, and volatility. Key news includes a fund-driven rally in natural gas futures, JP Morgan Chase facing a shareholder lawsuit regarding Enron exposure, and El Paso Corp's plan to sell Texas natural gas assets to El Paso Energy Partners. Additionally, AES announced plans to sell $1–$1.5 billion in assets to improve liquidity.

The MSPM0G series includes several functional peripherals: the Low-Frequency Sub-System (LFSS_B), which contains a real-time clock (RTC_B) and an asynchronous Independent Watchdog Timer (IWDT_B); a Windowed Watchdog Timer (WWDT); and two types of timers, general-purpose (TIMGx) and advanced (TIMAx). The device also features a Serial Wire Debug (SWD) interface, a Boot Strap Loader (BSL) for configuration and programming, and a memory-mapped FACTORY region for device identification and trim information.

Following an important win, the speaker discussed the team's performance, noting they skated better and improved their second-period play. The speaker addressed player contributions, line combinations, and the importance of winning faceoffs and managing the puck. Emphasizing team over individuals, the speaker noted the need to regroup, maintain poise, and focus on their own preparation rather than media perception to be successful in the series.

Ben Bishop discussed his recovery, his career path through different organizations, and the importance of maintaining a consistent approach regardless of whether a game is a preseason, regular season, or playoff matchup.

University of Michigan scientists have developed an "omniphobic" coating that can repel nearly every known liquid. The clear, durable substance, composed of fluorinated polyurethane and F-POSS, can be applied to surfaces like floors and phone screens to prevent grime buildup. Researchers are now studying the material to ensure it is not toxic.

The U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Alabama granted Waste Away Group, Inc.’s motion for summary judgment in the case of *Norrell v. Waste Away Group, Inc.* Plaintiff Paula Norrell alleged unlawful gender discrimination, specifically regarding a failure to promote and disparate impact under Title VII. The court found that while Norrell established a prima facie case for disparate treatment, she failed to prove that the defendant's decision to promote a male candidate was a pretext for discrimination. The court determined that the defendant provided legitimate, non-discriminatory reasons for the promotion and that Norrell's evidence of discriminatory animus consisted of isolated, unrelated remarks. The court also granted summary judgment on the disparate impact claim as the plaintiff did not pursue it after discovery.

Plug Power Inc (NASDAQ:PLUG) shares recently traded down 1.54% with a closing price of $1.92. Seven analysts have a mean 52-week price target of $3.22, ranging from $1.3 to $5. The average brokerage recommendation is 1.86, with ratings including one Buy, four Outperform, one Hold, and one Underperform. The stock has an ATR-14 of 0.08, an RSI of 51.76, and a market capitalization of $445.8 million.

Developed by Tex Winter, the Triangle Post Offense is a system based on defensive recognition, precise court spacing, and fundamental execution rather than set plays. It consists of three components: entry, a sideline triangle, and a weakside two-man game. The offense utilizes various entry methods to initiate play, emphasizing player movement and the ability to exploit defensive deployment through specific reads and counters. Success relies on players maintaining 15 to 20 feet of spacing and mastering individual skills to execute post splits, solo cuts, and weakside attacks.

Developed by John Bollinger in the 1980s, Bollinger Bands are technical indicators used to analyze asset volatility and potential trend changes. They consist of a central moving average with standard deviations projected above and below it. While useful for visualizing volatility and identifying breakouts, the indicator can produce false signals, experience delays, and be less effective in range-bound markets. Users can customize settings like the moving average period and standard deviation multiplier on platforms like TradingView to develop various trading strategies.

Queen Elizabeth met with victims of the Manchester Arena bombing, emergency responders, and medical staff at the Royal Manchester Children's Hospital. During her visit, she described the attack, which killed 22 and injured over 100, as "wicked."

In the second quarter, FTB Advisors Inc., Wells Fargo & Company MN, Eaton Vance Management, Allen Investment Management LLC, and Private Advisor Group LLC increased their holdings in Vanguard Total International Stock ETF, while Brighton Jones LLC established a new position.

The speaker accepts the sacred trust of the presidency, pledging to promote the people's welfare through a faithful application of democratic principles and the Constitution. He calls for citizens to prioritize patriotism over partisan strife and to uphold the Constitution's spirit of amity. The administration intends to follow a foreign policy of peace and neutrality, practice economical government, and implement civil-service reform based on merit. Additionally, the speaker addresses the need for sound finances, protection of the public domain, fair treatment of Indians, and the protection of freedmen's constitutional rights.

The TPS7H500x-SP series is a family of radiation-hardness-assured PWM controllers featuring a 0.613 V voltage reference and configurable switching frequencies from 100 kHz to 2 MHz. The series includes the dual-output TPS7H5001-SP, the single-output TPS7H5002-SP and TPS7H5003-SP, and the dual-output TPS7H5004-SP. These controllers are designed for space-grade DC-DC converters, supporting various topologies such as buck, push-pull, and full-bridge.

Primatologist Jane Goodall, who died on October 1 at age 91, collected chimpanzee skeletons from Gombe National Park to study how individual life experiences influence skeletal features. By preserving the remains of chimps with known histories, her work allows researchers to investigate developmental impacts on bone structure, providing insights that may eventually assist in the study of ancient hominids.

The author describes the second week of motherhood as a period of intense difficulty characterized by sleep deprivation, painful breastfeeding, baby weight-gain concerns, loneliness, and difficulty soothing a crying infant. These challenges contributed to emotional instability, depression, and conflict within her marriage.

On June 15, 2017, Amazon.com, Inc. entered into a Merger Agreement with Whole Foods Market, Inc. and Walnut Merger Sub, Inc. Under the agreement, Walnut Merger Sub will merge into Whole Foods Market, with Whole Foods Market continuing as the surviving company. Each outstanding share of Whole Foods Market common stock will be converted into the right to receive $42.00 in cash. To fund the merger, Amazon has entered into a commitment letter for a senior unsecured bridge term loan facility of up to $13.7 billion.

Developed by William J. O’Neil, the follow-through day is a market-timing concept used to identify the transition from a downtrend or correction to a new uptrend. A rally attempt begins on "Day 1" when a major index closes higher than the previous day. For the attempt to remain valid, the index must not fall below the Day 1 low during the subsequent two days. A follow-through day occurs on Day 4 or later of a valid rally attempt, characterized by a major index closing significantly higher with increased volume. While backtesting on the S&P 500 showed poor short-term results due to market mean reversion, the signal is intended to help investors identify the onset of a new bull market.

The double top is a bearish reversal chart pattern consisting of two swing highs at approximately the same resistance level and a swing low that forms a neckline support. Appearing at the end of an uptrend, the pattern indicates a potential downward price reversal once the neckline is broken. Traders may close long positions or open short positions upon a neckline break, using the pattern's height to estimate profit targets. Research by Thomas Bulkowski indicates that only 39% of these formations reach their targets, making the strategy difficult to trade.

On October 29, 2001, Enron Corp. shares fell to near seven-year lows following a credit rating downgrade by Moody's Investors Service. Moody's lowered Enron's senior unsecured long-term debt rating from Baa1 to Baa2 and placed its commercial paper rating on review. The downgrade followed Enron's disclosure of a $638 million third-quarter loss and $1.2 billion in equity write-downs related to undisclosed partnerships managed by former CFO Andrew Fastow. To bolster liquidity and investor confidence, Enron is negotiating for new credit lines between $1 billion and $2 billion after previously drawing down $3 billion in credit to repay commercial paper. While some U.S. energy traders report business as usual, several European energy groups have frozen dealings with the company due to credit concerns.

Retired Metro Police homicide detective Phil Ramos commented on the released October 1 police body camera videos, noting the detectives' visible stress and anxiety. Ramos defended the first officer for not activating his body camera during a potential firefight and suggested an accidental discharge could result from high tension. He also noted the absence of a time stamp on the footage and cautioned against drawing conclusions from these videos alone.

A heat wave affecting the northeastern United States is expected to move west toward southern California. The National Weather Service reported heat index values reaching 106 degrees Fahrenheit in New York City and at least one heat-related death in Pennsylvania. An air quality alert was issued for the New York area, though a storm front is expected to provide cooling relief to the eastern seaboard later this week.

Despite heightened political polarization and pandemic-induced challenges, substantive cross-partisan education policy is being implemented at the state level. Successful initiatives often share five key factors: clear and easy-to-communicate policy proposals, responsiveness to local contexts, the provision of political cover for stakeholders, the ability for all sides to claim a "win," and the use of media as an accelerant. To achieve these successes, advocates are encouraged to understand the political landscape, prioritize core missions, and frame issues as expanding opportunities rather than narrowing them.

For the three months ended September 30, 2021, Microsoft Corporation reported total revenue of $45.3 billion, an increase from $37.2 billion in 2020. Net income rose to $20.5 billion, compared to $13.9 billion in the prior year, aided by a $3.3 billion net income tax benefit from the transfer of intangible properties. Revenue growth occurred across all segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

This systematic review and meta-analysis of five studies published between 2016 and 2023 found a pooled Chikungunya seroprevalence of 12.35% in Ethiopia. Prevalence varied by geographical location, with the highest reported in the Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples' Region (43.6%) and the lowest in Dire Dawa (approximately 12%). Risk factors associated with varying seroprevalence included occupation, education, age, and sex. Subgroup analyses revealed significant heterogeneity based on study area and the type of diagnostic test used (ELISA vs. RT-qPCR).

As the 2018 NFL Draft approaches, the Indianapolis Colts hold nine picks, including the No. 6 overall selection. Top prospects for the first-round pick include NC State EDGE Bradley Chubb, Notre Dame IOL Quenton Nelson, and Penn State RB Saquon Barkley.

This book explores distributed system patterns, focusing on the use of containers and container orchestration to build reliable, scalable, and agile applications. It details single-node patterns, such as the sidecar, ambassador, and adapter patterns, which utilize modular, reusable containers to augment functionality, broker interactions, or normalize interfaces. The text also covers multi-node distributed patterns, including replicated load-balanced stateless services—which can be enhanced with caching and SSL termination layers—and sharded services, which are used to scale stateful services by partitioning data across multiple machines.

Developed by Joseph Piotroski, the Piotroski F-Score is a stock selection method that uses nine financial criteria—covering profitability, liquidity, and efficiency—to identify undervalued stocks with strong fundamentals. Scores of 8 or 9 indicate strong financials, while scores of 0 to 4 indicate poor financials. Backtesting by Alpha Architect on NYSE stocks and ValueSignals on European stocks suggests the strategy can outperform the S&P 500. While useful for identifying value and growth stocks, the strategy should be used alongside other research and is not a guarantee of success.

Patrick McCaffery, a consensus four-star recruit and 6-foot-8 wing/forward, has committed to the University of Iowa. The decision allows him to play for his father, head coach Fran McCaffery, alongside his brother, Connor McCaffery.

During Supreme Court oral arguments, several justices expressed willingness to permit trial courts to prohibit defense lawyers from discussing a client's specific testimony during overnight recesses while still allowing discussions regarding trial strategy and management. The case originated from David Villarreal, who challenged a Texas court's order that restricted his attorney from discussing his testimony during a recess. While the defense argued such restrictions could lead to self-censorship and violate the Sixth Amendment, justices debated where to draw the line between permissible strategic advice and impermissible coaching.

The passage details various containerization patterns used to manage applications on single or multiple nodes. Single-node patterns include the **sidecar pattern**, which augments an application container with additional functionality (e.g., adding HTTPS or configuration management); the **ambassador pattern**, which brokers external interactions (e.g., service discovery or request splitting); and the **adapter pattern**, which standardizes interfaces for monitoring, logging, or health checks.

Multi-node distributed patterns focus on microservices to improve reliability and scaling. Key patterns include **replicated load-balanced services** for stateless applications, which can incorporate caching and SSL termination layers, and **sharded services** for stateful applications. Sharding increases data capacity by distributing it across multiple nodes, often utilizing consistent hashing to minimize remapping during scaling.

This lecture covers lower bounds for the predecessor problem, specifically focusing on the optimality of Van Emde Boas and fusion tries. The instructor explains that while upper bounds often rely on complex bit tricks, lower bounds can be derived through communication complexity and information theory.

The lecture provides a historical survey of predecessor lower bounds, from Asvab Atjai (1988) to the tight $n, w,$ and space trade-offs established by Patrascu and Thorup (2006, 2007). The core of the lecture focuses on a proof technique called "round elimination," which is used to establish a lower bound for the "colored predecessor problem." This technique involves a communication model between Alice (the query) and Bob (the data structure/memory). By iteratively eliminating messages and managing error probabilities, the instructor demonstrates how to derive a symmetric lower bound of $\min(\log_a w, \log_b n)$, which closely matches known upper bounds for polynomial space data structures, differing only by a $\log \log$ factor.

This report covers the narrative up to the January 17, 1893, revolution and includes a chronological list of papers, an index, and a bibliography. It also details various historical documents and treaties, such as the 1826 Treaty of Friendship, Commerce, and Navigation between the United States and the Sandwich Islands.
Ahead of their match against Arsenal, Middlesbrough striker Rudy Gestede stated the team must remain positive to avoid relegation. Middlesbrough currently sits 19th in the Premier League.

The NVIDIA Ampere GA10x architecture, including GA102 and GA104 GPUs, builds on the Turing architecture to provide improved performance and energy efficiency. GA10x GPUs feature second-generation RT Cores that double ray/triangle intersection testing rates and allow concurrent RT, graphics, or compute workloads. Third-generation Tensor Cores introduce a Sparsity feature to double throughput and support new data types like Tensor Float 32. The GA10x SM architecture doubles peak FP32 processing rates by enabling FP32 operations on both datapaths. Additionally, the architecture utilizes GDDR6X memory, third-generation NVLink, and PCIe Gen 4 to enhance bandwidth and data transfer.

A study of individuals with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) found that immunosuppressive therapies impact SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccine responses. Rituximab, a B cell-depleting therapy, resulted in nearly undetectable anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibodies. Abatacept treatment significantly reduced S-specific and neutralizing antibodies, as well as the production of key cytokines IL-2, IFNγ, and IL-21 by S-specific CD4+ T cells, and impaired B cell class switching. While MTX-treated subjects showed reduced S-specific CD4+ T cell frequency, they did not show significant differences in antibody levels or B cell phenotype compared to controls.

Indonesia’s sovereign wealth fund, Danantara, will launch at least eight waste-to-power projects by the end of October to address waste management and boost renewable energy. Starting in Jakarta, the initiative aims to process 1,000 tonnes of waste daily per plant to generate 15 megawatts of electricity. The projects align with Indonesia’s 2025–2034 electricity plan and will be integrated into the national grid via state utility PLN.

MTN and four banks are seeking to raise a combined GH¢4.67 billion on the Ghana Stock Exchange within six months. MTN aims to offload 35 per cent of its firm for GH¢3.48 billion, while Access Bank, Agricultural Development Bank, Republic Bank, and Societe Generale seek GH¢1.19 billion to meet Bank of Ghana capital requirements. While the influx of foreign investment could stabilize the cedi, dividend repatriation could cause depreciation. Experts note that while pension assets provide a cushion, success may depend on foreign participation and retail investor interest.

This study developed and formally validated an Arabic version of the Orthognathic Quality of Life Questionnaire (OQLQ) among Saudi Arabian patients. The instrument demonstrated excellent internal consistency and test-retest reliability, with the exception of the "awareness of dentofacial deformity" domain. Construct validity was supported by correlations between OQLQ scores and surgical satisfaction and appearance. Responsiveness testing showed that overall OQLQ scores significantly improved after surgery, with the facial esthetics subdomain also showing significant improvement in paired analysis.

The Supreme Court will decide if the ex post facto clause applies to the Mandatory Victims Restitution Act. The justices must determine if restitution imposed as part of a criminal sentence constitutes a criminal punishment or a civil remedy. Holsey Ellingburg argues that because restitution is part of a criminal sentence, uses criminal procedures, and carries incarceration penalties for non-compliance, it should be subject to constitutional protections against retroactive laws.

Delta Air Lines Inc. intends to acquire up to an additional 32 percent of Grupo Aeroméxico's outstanding capital stock for MXP$43.59 per share via a tender offer, pending regulatory approvals. Following the offer, Delta and its pension trust would own or hold options for up to 49 percent of the shares.
The Eighth Circuit Court of Appeals dismissed the appeal in United States v. Frank Walker upon the appellant's motion and the appellee's consent, with no costs to either party.

Tradeshift raised $250 million in a Series E funding round led by Goldman Sachs and PSP Investments, bringing its total funding to over $400 million and its valuation above $1.1 billion. Co-founder Mikkel Hippe Brun will join the company's board.

Entrepreneur and investor Steve Pearse discusses the realities of starting a company, noting that while most startups fail, success requires planning for an exit via acquisition or going public. He emphasizes the importance of a powerful "elevator pitch" that uses a "hook" to induce investor greed, avoids technical jargon, and focuses on customer benefits rather than just technology. Pearse advises raising money when it is not urgently needed, orchestrating pitches in parallel to create competition, and maintaining focus while remaining flexible enough to pivot. Ultimately, he highlights leadership, passion, and confidence as essential traits for success.

The team is focused on the next game, noting that they are more comfortable and must play their game to be successful. They have a deep roster and a strong road record. The speaker credited the owner's financial commitment to the team's success and praised a teammate's hard work and performance.

This systematic review synthesized 23 level IV studies to examine how personality traits influence student satisfaction and success in higher education online learning. Using Big Five and Myers-Briggs models, the review found that conscientiousness, openness, and agreeableness often correlate with higher engagement, satisfaction, and GPA, while neuroticism is frequently associated with lower success and satisfaction. The findings highlight a research gap in occupational therapy education and suggest that educators can support diverse learners through Universal Design for Learning and by fostering self-regulated learning skills.

In November 1977, the Leeds Revolutionary Feminist Group organized the UK’s first Reclaim the Night marches to protest against harassment and violence toward women. The event, which inspired feminist groups nationwide to march, has been revived and serves as the inspiration for RashDash's new performance, *The Darkest Corners*, being held in a Holbeck car park.

Southwestern College adjuncts held a rally to advocate for better wages, equal protections, and benefits comparable to full-time instructors. Speakers highlighted issues such as long travel times, job instability, and lack of medical benefits. College President Dr. Kindred Murillo and Trustee Roberto Alcantar spoke in support of the adjunct faculty.

The NVIDIA Turing GPU architecture introduces several technological advancements:

* **Connectivity:** VirtualLink, an open industry standard, uses a single USB-C connector to provide the power, display, and data required for VR headsets.
* **Multi-GPU:** Turing TU102 and TU104 GPUs utilize NVLink for high-bandwidth GPU-to-GPU data transfers, replacing previous MIO and PCIe interfaces for SLI.
* **Hybrid Rendering:** This model combines traditional rasterization with real-time ray tracing. Dedicated RT Cores accelerate Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) traversal and ray-triangle intersection testing to enable realistic reflections, refractions, and shadows.
* **AI and Deep Learning:** The NVIDIA NGX stack uses Turing Tensor Cores to power AI-based features such as Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS) for image enhancement, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez.
* **Advanced Shading:** Mesh Shading introduces Task and Mesh Shaders to reduce CPU bottlenecks, while Variable Rate Shading (VRS) allows for fine-grained control over shading rates to optimize performance. Texture Space Shading (TSS) decouples shading from the screen-space pixel grid.
* **Multi-View Rendering (MVR):** This expands on previous technology to allow efficient rendering from multiple viewpoints in a single pass, benefiting VR and shadow mapping.

Demi Guo and Chenlin Meng co-founded Pika, an AI video company that has raised approximately $135 million. Pika recently launched a TikTok-like app featuring "Predictive Video," a tool designed for Gen Z and Gen Alpha self-expression. Meanwhile, the AI boom is driving up San Francisco rents, TSMC reported a 39% profit surge due to chip demand, and Spotify is partnering with major music labels to develop AI products. Additionally, only 11% of Americans say they would consider using AI mental health tools.

This study investigated Colombian undergraduate students' perceptions and preferences regarding online learning (OL) and emergency remote education (ERE). Using the add-on preferential groups (APG) model, researchers compared the two modalities across dimensions such as content quality, interaction, and assessment. Results indicated that while students generally held positive views of both, they rated OL higher in most categories, including content quality, learning assessment, and asynchronous activity development. Conversely, students perceived student-to-student interaction as more effective in the ERE modality. The findings suggest a need for ongoing instructor training in digital tools and the design of authentic, interactive assessment strategies to improve post-pandemic learning experiences.

Mark Cuban stated that President Trump’s proposed TrumpRx.gov platform, a government-operated site to sell discounted prescription drugs directly to consumers, could be impactful if it forces pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) to change. While Pfizer has partnered with the program to offer drugs at direct-to-consumer costs, experts note that such platforms may primarily benefit the uninsured because they often cannot accept insurance.

The Russell 2000 is a market-weighted index measuring approximately 2,000 U.S. small-cap stocks. It undergoes annual rebalancing on the fourth Friday of June to ensure the index accurately reflects its intended universe and methodology. This process involves adding or removing companies and adjusting weights based on changes in market capitalization. Rebalancing can create market imbalances due to the necessary buying and selling of securities. Backtesting suggests a trading strategy capitalizing on the index's typical end-of-June rally—buying after June 23rd and selling in early July—yields an average gain of 1.34% over a six-day holding period.

The Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card offers unlimited 2% cash rewards on purchases, a $200 bonus after spending $500 in the first three months, and 0% intro APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. It features a $0 annual fee and up to $600 in cell phone protection. The Capital One Quicksilver Cash Rewards Credit Card provides 1.5% cash back on purchases, 5% on select travel via Capital One Travel, and a $300 limited-time welcome bonus. It includes 0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 15 months and has no annual fee. A Citi balance transfer offer provides 0% intro APR for 18 months.

Digital leaders use transparent, data-driven objectives to align organizations vertically and horizontally, creating a shared "North Star" vision. While this culture coordinates efforts through consistent values and metrics, leaders must avoid over-relying on data to the point of stifling intuition. In contrast, digital laggards struggle with misalignment due to poorly connected goals and a lack of cultural integration. Organizations typically fall into four patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, or data reliant—based on their current technical sophistication and cultural maturity.

The President returns a bill appropriating $1,378,450 for various harbor and river improvements, objecting to its constitutionality. He argues the Constitution does not grant the Federal Government the power to fund internal improvements within states, as such powers are not expressed or necessary to execute expressed powers. He contends that sanctioning the bill would lead to a consolidation of federal power, sectional prejudice, and wasteful expenditures of the common Treasury on local projects. Additionally, he notes the impropriety of such spending during a foreign war and the potential for increasing public debt.

Coach Deboer noted that his team played tentatively early in the game but improved as they became more comfortable. He stated the team must find another level to succeed and will use two days to self-analyze before Saturday night. Deboer emphasized the importance of battling through frustration, drawing parallels to their experience against Lundqvist, and noted that the organization relies on its wealth of experience to maintain a "business as usual" routine.

The speaker expressed disappointment after a loss to Boston, crediting Boston's goaltending and play for their win. Despite missed chances and injuries, the team will focus on the process for the upcoming seventh game of the Stanley Cup finals, where Jeff will have an opportunity to play.

This statistical analysis plan outlines the methods for analyzing data from Zealand Pharma A/S protocol ZP4207-17086, a phase 3, randomized, double-blind trial. The study aims to demonstrate that a 0.6 mg dose of dasiglucagon is superior to placebo and comparable to GlucaGen® in treating hypoglycemia in children with type I diabetes mellitus. The trial will assess efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetic profiles across multiple centers in Europe and the USA. Primary efficacy analysis will utilize the Full Analysis Set (FAS) to evaluate time to plasma glucose recovery, while safety analyses will be based on the safety analysis set.

The NVIDIA GA10x Ampere architecture introduces several technological advancements, including GDDR6X memory utilizing PAM4 signaling to achieve high bandwidth, such as 936 GB/sec on the GeForce RTX 3090. The architecture features second-generation RT Cores for improved ray tracing and third-generation Tensor Cores with structural sparsity for enhanced AI performance. NVIDIA RTX IO is a suite of technologies designed to accelerate I/O performance by enabling GPU-based lossless decompression of assets, working with Microsoft’s DirectStorage API to reduce CPU load. Additionally, the architecture supports high-resolution displays via HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4a, and includes fifth-generation NVDEC for hardware-accelerated video decoding, including AV1. For data center applications, the NVIDIA A40 GPU provides significant throughput improvements in FP32, ray tracing, and AI training compared to previous generations.
On May 1, 2018, Apple Inc. issued a press release and related data sheet regarding its financial results for the second fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2018.

Reports suggest Queen Elizabeth II may abdicate the throne to Prince Charles when she turns 95 to ensure a seamless transition. Under "Plan Regency," the Regency Act could grant Charles full power while the Queen is still alive.

On April 12, 2021, Microsoft Corporation announced a definitive agreement to acquire Nuance Communications, Inc. in an all-cash transaction valued at $19.7 billion, including net debt, at $56.00 per share.

The Office of Management and Budget has identified between 4,132 and 4,232 federal workers for layoffs during the government shutdown. Affected departments include the Treasury, Health and Human Services, Housing and Urban Development, Commerce, and Homeland Security. While some agencies state the cuts target non-essential roles or align with administration priorities, the American Federation of Government Employees has filed suit, alleging the layoffs are unlawful.

International tribunals and the Bering Sea Commission have applied the rule that damages for the arrest or detention of a vessel should be measured by the loss of its probable catch or use. Examples include the *Hope On*, the *Col. Lloyd Aspinwall*, and several cases before the Bering Sea Commission, such as the *Favorite* and the *Triumph*. Additionally, it is not permissible to enroll aliens into a national force without their consent.

While momentum investing suggests assets continue their current trend, the SPY exhibits short-term mean-reversion, tending to be higher after red days. A backtested strategy of buying after a red day and selling after a green day produced higher CAGR, better risk-adjusted returns, and lower drawdown than a buy-and-hold strategy.

The Option Investor Newsletter from January 21, 1999, reports on market volatility, specifically a significant sell-off in Internet and technology stocks. While Microsoft reported strong earnings, the Nasdaq and Dow Jones Industrial Average experienced declines due to global currency concerns, profit-taking, and fears of a bursting Internet bubble. The newsletter provides individual stock analyses, earnings updates, and technical outlooks for various companies, including Nokia, Dell, Cisco, AOL, and Sun Microsystems.

Ofcom has proposed an automatic compensation scheme for fixed broadband and landline customers regarding service outages, delayed installations, or missed engineer appointments. The plan could provide up to £185m annually to 2.6 million customers via cash or bill credits. A consultation is open until 5 June, with a decision expected by year-end.

The 2017 Sonora High School Athletic Hall of Fame inductees include Howard “Socky” Keefe, Dennis Jackson, Don Moore, Cam Fray, Jon Wagner, Mark McCollough, Becky Fray Aguilar, Jodi Gardella Richey, Lloyd Gaspar, Jessica Peterson McCornack, Gary Smith, and Lexi Kopf Scoles. These athletes and coaches represent graduates from 1950 to 2008.

Censorship is expanding into higher education through conservative movements targeting diversity, gender, and politics, as seen at New College of Florida and military academies. Legislative proposals and administration compacts aim to regulate syllabi and institutional units, threatening academic freedom and federal funding.

The ruling rejected a constitutional challenge regarding the commerce clause and emphasized that "place of worship" must be construed broadly.

The Carter administration used MONs for high-risk or specific operations, requiring interagency coordination. In *St. Louis & San Francisco Railroad Company v. Conarty*, the court affirmed a judgment for the administratrix of W. G. Conarty's estate. The court held that the defendant was liable under the Safety Appliance Act because a disabled coal car, being moved for repairs, lacked required safety equipment, which directly caused the death of a switchman during a collision. The court ruled that the car remained in use for interstate commerce, the right of action for pain and suffering survived to the personal representative under the Federal Employers Liability Act, and the widow's testimony regarding financial contributions was admissible as collateral to the main issue of liability. Additionally, the court upheld the prohibition against removing the case to federal court.

The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe stated the official US dollar to bond note exchange rate is 1:1 and advised the public to use one of 45 licensed financial institutions to avoid black market distortions. Governor Dr. John Mangudya noted that arrests have been made following new regulations criminalizing illegal forex trading. Additionally, the bank urged the public to report retailers who refuse non-cash payment modes.

The U.S. dollar reached three-week highs after New York Fed President William Dudley suggested only a "little pause" in interest rate hikes. While U.S. jobs growth slowed in March, the unemployment rate fell to 4.5 percent. Meanwhile, the euro faced pressure due to uncertainty regarding the French presidential election.

For time-dependent signals in continuous-wave interferometry using a pair of squeezed states with finite bandwidth $\Delta\Omega$, the precision of phase estimation is bounded by a spectral quantum Cramer-Rao bound. For a photon flux $n \gg 2$, Heisenberg scaling is achieved. This bound can be attained using a nonlinear estimator that rectifies filtered homodyne detector records.

This study aims to evaluate the prognostic value of the prognostic nutrition index (PNI), neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR) in patients with chronic hepatitis C-associated cirrhosis complicated by type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Researchers analyzed 56 patients with both conditions, 85 with hepatitis C-associated cirrhosis, and 85 with T2DM.

The Rubber Band trading strategy is a contrarian, mean-reversion approach for trading stocks that aims to identify overbought or oversold conditions. It relies on the principle that prices tend to revert to a central mean after moving significantly away from it. Traders may use indicators such as Keltner Channels, Bollinger Bands, or momentum oscillators to identify these points. Using Keltner Channels, a buy setup occurs when the price trades below the lower band, while a sell setup occurs when the price trades above the upper band.

Additionally, the University of Edinburgh has faced criticism for asking law lecturers to provide recorded lectures to mitigate the impact of the industrial action.

This study utilized a two-stage machine learning framework to explore how integrating plasma biomarkers (Aβ42/40, p-tau 181, and NfL) with MRI data, demographics, APOE4, and cognitive assessments can predict the rate of cognitive decline and progression to dementia. Using ADNI data, researchers found that combining these non-invasive measures significantly improved the prediction of memory-related cognitive decline (ADNI-MEM) compared to basic models. While plasma biomarkers and MRI scores were strong predictors for memory, executive function, and language domains, they were less effective for visuospatial decline. The combined model demonstrated the highest predictive accuracy for both cognitively unimpaired and MCI individuals progressing toward dementia.

A report from the National Academy of Sciences and the National Academy of Medicine suggests that scientists should only be allowed to alter heritable DNA to prevent serious diseases, rather than for trait enhancement. The panel recommends that clinical trials for germline editing be pursued only when no reasonable alternatives exist, be conducted under public scrutiny, and include long-term follow-up studies.

TeraAgent is a new distributed simulation engine designed to overcome the scalability limitations of BioDynaMo, which is restricted to single-server shared-memory parallelism. By utilizing a scale-out architecture that divides simulation space across multiple servers, TeraAgent enables extreme-scale simulations of up to 501.51 billion agents on 84,096 CPU cores. The engine implements a specialized serialization mechanism to reduce data movement overheads and a delta encoding scheme to compress communication during aura updates. These improvements allow for seamless model execution across various hardware, improved interoperability with third-party tools like ParaView, and significantly higher agent update rates compared to existing platforms.

This paper proposes a model-based geostatistical (MBG) methodology to design more cost-efficient soil-transmitted helminth (STH) impact assessment surveys (IAS). By integrating baseline prevalence data, environmental risk factors, and preventive chemotherapy (PC) history through a multi-state Markov model, the approach aims to reduce sample sizes without losing precision. Applied to data from Kenya, Zimbabwe, and Sierra Leone, the MBG method achieved equivalent accuracy to classical survey methods while reducing average survey costs by 80%.

The present invention relates to a vehicle vision, driver assistance, or driver monitoring system that utilizes one or more cameras to capture interior and exterior image data. The system estimates a driver's attention by calculating the difference between a maximum workload and the sum of the driver's estimated driving and distraction workloads. Pairs trading is a market-neutral statistical arbitrage strategy that involves simultaneously buying and selling two highly correlated financial instruments, such as stocks, to profit from the convergence or divergence of their price spread. While the strategy aims to remain profitable regardless of market direction, it involves risks such as increased leverage, transaction costs, and the potential for assets to diverge permanently. Successful implementation often requires analyzing correlation and cointegration to identify mispricings.

This application provides a method, apparatus, and computer-readable medium for displaying a marker element in a virtual scene. When a user or teammate marks a target virtual item, a terminal renders and displays a marker element at a designated location around that item in the virtual scene's display interface. The system may also display distance information, such as straight-line distance, horizontal distance, or height difference, and a marker icon on a thumbnail map. The server determines if the target item is within a visible distance of a user's virtual object before transmitting marker indication information to relevant terminals.

This lecture discusses the implementation of linear shift-invariant systems described by linear constant coefficient difference equations using digital networks. These systems can be represented graphically through block diagram notation—utilizing delay, multiplication, and addition elements—or via signal flow graphs. Signal flow graphs consist of nodes and directed branches, and for linear systems, they can be expressed as a set of coupled first-order difference equations using matrix notation. This matrix representation separates the system into a coefficient matrix and a delay matrix. The lecture also addresses computability, noting that a network is computable if its nodes can be ordered such that the coefficient matrix has no non-zero elements on or above the main diagonal, a condition violated by delay-free loops.

The lecture discusses privilege separation, focusing on the "confused deputy problem" and the capability-based system, Capsicum. The confused deputy problem occurs when an application implicitly uses its ambient authority (such as a setuid-like privilege) to perform operations on behalf of a user that the user should not be able to authorize. 

In contrast, capabilities allow for explicit privilege management. In a capability-based model, access is granted via unforgeable tokens (similar to Unix file descriptors) that point to specific objects with defined restrictions. Capsicum implements this in FreeBSD by using a `cap_enter` system call to enter a sandboxing mode that eliminates access to global namespaces, such as the file system, network, and PIDs, requiring all operations to be performed through existing file descriptors. The lecture also covers the `lch_start` API for creating clean sandboxes and the use of the Casper daemon to handle necessary external requests, such as DNS queries, while maintaining isolation.

The Magic Formula is a stock selection strategy popularized by Joel Greenblatt that identifies undervalued, financially strong companies by ranking them based on two metrics: return on capital (ROIC) and earnings yield (EY). This lecture demonstrates how to design digital low-pass infinite impulse response (IIR) filters using analog Butterworth filters via two techniques: impulse invariance and the bilinear transformation. Using specific digital specifications—a passband edge at 0.2π with less than 1dB deviation and a stopband edge at 0.3π with at least 15dB attenuation—the speaker illustrates the design process for both methods. 

For impulse invariance, analog specifications are scaled to account for the transformation, and the filter order is rounded up to the nearest integer to compensate for aliasing. For the bilinear transformation, digital frequencies are pre-warped into analog frequencies using an arctangent curve. The speaker notes that while both methods result in similar monotonic frequency responses, the bilinear transformation provides better attenuation at higher frequencies due to frequency distortion.

This document standardizes the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) to enable interoperability between guest operating systems and hypervisors using SEV-ES or SEV-SNP features. The Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) is a 4 KB decrypted page used for communication between a guest and a hypervisor. Its format mirrors the SEV-ES VMCB save state area to facilitate hypervisor interaction while limiting guest state exposure. Version 2 of the protocol introduces SEV-SNP support, hypervisor feature advertisement via a 52-bit bitmap, and enhancements such as XSS MSR value addition and restricted APIC emulation. Subsequent revisions added support for 64-bit guest request message sequence numbers, APIC ID lists, multiple VMPL levels, SEV-TIO, Secure AVIC, and various NAE events. The GHCB is managed via MSR 0xc001_0130, and SEV-SNP guests must register their GHCB guest physical address (GPA) to ensure proper communication.

This study investigated the relationship between serum cardiac Troponin T (cTnT) levels and respiratory dysfunction in patients with Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) using two cohorts. This specification update for the AMD Geode™ CS5535 Companion Device (Silicon Revision A3) details several hardware issues and required resolutions. Key findings include:

* **Protection and Addressing:** The CS5535 lacks USB over-voltage protection, requiring external circuits. LBAR values of 10000h or higher are illegal under x86 but have no operational impact.
* **Interrupts and Clocks:** Automatic hardware clock gating can cause PIC failures if an edge-configured interrupt source remains high, potentially hanging the system. Similarly, clock gating in USB controllers or CEIR mode can cause register read failures or inactivity.
* **Data Integrity:** UDMA write CRC corruption can occur due to host terminations during preceding UDMA reads. Misaligned PRD tables in ATAC or ACC can cause errors during prefetching.
* **Register Access:** Byte, WORD, or BYTE accesses to certain ACPI and PMC registers may cause hangs or data corruption.
* **System Behavior:** Certain wake event inputs do not function from the ACPI S3 state, and specific timing or synchronization issues affect PCI, SMBus, and LPC operations.

This study introduces AnveshanaAI, a practice-based AI/ML learning platform designed to address gaps in existing systems regarding adaptive question generation, difficulty calibration, and peer feedback. The researchers constructed a dataset of over 10,000 problem-answer pairs enriched with metadata such as Bloom’s taxonomy levels and difficulty annotations. The platform features a learner panel with gamified progress tracking and an administrator panel for challenge design and performance analytics. Utilizing a modular architecture, the system incorporates fine-tuned Mistral-7B models, Docker-based sandboxes, and a "Viva Mode" for oral-style assessments. Experimental results validated the dataset's pedagogical reliability and the model's stable convergence, high recall, and interpretable reasoning.

Polkadot is a scalable, heterogeneous multi-chain framework designed to provide shared security, interoperability, and scalability for multiple blockchains. It utilizes a decentralized computer network consisting of a relay-chain and multiple parallelized chains called parachains. The system decouples consensus from execution to improve scalability and allows diverse blockchains to communicate and pool security.

The network operates through several key roles:
* **Validators:** High-stake nodes that seal blocks on the relay-chain and validate parachain candidate blocks.
* **Nominators:** Stakeholders who contribute to a validator's security bond.
* **Collators:** Parties that assist validators by producing valid parachain blocks.
* **Fishermen:** Independent actors who monitor the network for malicious behavior to earn rewards.

Interchain communication is achieved through a routing system where transactions move between parachains via the relay-chain. The framework also supports interoperability with other networks, such as Ethereum and Bitcoin, through specialized bridging mechanisms.

This randomized controlled trial investigated whether combining radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) with a specific rehabilitation program (RP) is more effective than RP alone for treating acute hamstring muscle complex (HMC) injury type 3b in athletes. The study found that the rESWT + RP group had a significantly shorter mean time to return to sport (25.4 ± 3.5 days) compared to the sham rESWT + RP group (28.3 ± 4.5 days). No significant differences were found between the groups regarding patient satisfaction or re-injury rates at six months.

U.S. stocks fell Tuesday after Caterpillar stated it does not expect to exceed its first-quarter profit for the remainder of the year, sparking investor fears that rising costs will slow growth. The Dow Jones industrial average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq composite all declined, with industrial, technology, and materials companies seeing significant losses. In Jane Richmond v. Walter M. Richmond, the court addressed alimony and child maintenance following a divorce for adultery and cruelty. Determining that no fixed rule exists for such allowances, the Chancellor ruled that amounts must be based on the specific circumstances of the case, the defendant's property value at the time of the master's report, and the children's need to be maintained according to the father's condition in life. Due to new evidence regarding the defendant's reduced property value and increased debts, the court reduced the master's recommended total from $872 to $640 annually. The final decree ordered the defendant to pay $250 annually for the wife's alimony and $390 annually for the support of the three children, while reserving the court's power to vary these amounts upon a future change of circumstances.

Veterans warn that a concrete dome on Runit Island, which entombs radioactive waste from US nuclear tests, is leaking radiation into the Pacific Ocean due to weathering, rising sea levels, and porous coral. Cleanup workers report inadequate safety gear and claim the mission caused various radiation-related health issues. Experts note that the level of danger depends on how radioactivity is dispersed and ingested.

The professor discusses the theorem of irrelevance, which states that in detection theory, components outside the signal's degrees of freedom can be ignored if they are independent of the signal and noise. In a white Gaussian noise channel, all modulation systems are equivalent regarding noise analysis. The lecture also compares signal-by-signal detection with joint maximum likelihood detection, noting that while independent signals yield identical results, dependent signals (such as those in coded systems) benefit from joint detection. Additionally, the professor explores orthogonal, simplex, and biorthogonal codes, explaining their energy and error probability characteristics. Finally, the lecture transitions to wireless communication, contrasting it with wired systems by highlighting challenges like time-varying channels, interference, and the complexities of cellular network structures.

Microsoft Corporation is filing this Form 8-K to recast certain amounts in its 2015 Form 10-K to reflect new segment reporting based on an organizational structure realignment. The disclosure relates to a display apparatus featuring a flexible vibration module disposed on the rear surface of a display panel to generate sound or haptic feedback. The module includes a piezoelectric composite layer comprising alternating inorganic material portions with piezoelectric characteristics and organic material portions providing flexibility and impact resistance. This structure allows the module to be applied to curved, rollable, or bendable displays. Various embodiments describe different patterns and sizes for these portions to optimize sound pressure, localization, and frequency response. Additionally, the apparatus may utilize multiple vibration modules and partition members to create air gaps, enabling two-channel stereo sound.

Mega Geometry enables fast subdivision surface ray tracing by mapping the tessellation process to cluster generation and constructing BVHs from the resulting CLASes.

The bullish engulfing pattern is a two-candlestick reversal pattern occurring after a downward price swing, where a large green candlestick completely consumes a smaller red candlestick. Often found near support levels, it signals a potential shift from bearish to bullish momentum. Successful trading involves building a plan that incorporates entry and exit criteria, risk management, and backtesting using historical data. Traders can enhance strategies through advanced techniques and market analysis while avoiding common mistakes to improve success rates.

This prospective cohort study of 264 hospitalized COVID-19 patients found that the mean lung ultrasound score (mLUSS) and individual findings, such as B lines and pleural line abnormalities, were associated with an increased risk of progression to ICU-level care and 28-day mortality. The mLUSS provided prognostic value even when all 12 lung zones could not be scanned. Conversely, the presence of A lines was associated with a decreased risk of clinical deterioration and death.

A study at Providence evaluated a pathologist-directed protocol using a 523-gene comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) assay for 3,216 advanced cancer patients. The program, which provided testing at no cost to patients, found that 49% of cases had at least one guideline-based actionable biomarker. Compared to a simulated 50-gene panel, CGP identified significantly more actionable mutations and clinical trial matches. Results showed that patients receiving biomarker-guided targeted therapy or immunotherapy had improved overall survival compared to those receiving chemotherapy alone, with a median survival of 25 months versus 17 months.

FoLix is an FDA-cleared, noninvasive fractional laser treatment for early to moderate hair loss in men and women. This qualitative case study investigated the experiences of seven visually impaired undergraduate and graduate music students in Turkey regarding distance education during the COVID-19 pandemic. Findings revealed that while distance education offers temporal and spatial flexibility, it presents significant challenges due to technical inadequacies in sound synchronization and a lack of accessible digital content. Most students utilized synchronous models and computers, yet many reported that course materials were not tailored to their special needs, often requiring parental or peer support. The study concludes that for distance music education to be effective for visually impaired students, institutions must implement accessible technologies—such as screen readers, Braille printing, and audio-converted documents—and customize educational programming to accommodate diverse developmental needs.

The United States brought an action against Hale County, Alabama, and its officials to enforce the Voting Rights Act of 1965. The court ordered that the November 2, 1976, election proceed with provisional commissioners and directed the defendants to submit the enactments to the Attorney General for expedited review.

The NVIDIA Ampere GA10x architecture introduces several hardware advancements, including second-generation RT Cores that double ray/triangle intersection testing rates and third-generation Tensor Cores featuring fine-grained structured sparsity to double throughput. The architecture supports double-speed FP32 processing and utilizes GDDR6X memory with PAM4 signaling for increased bandwidth. Additionally, the GA10x architecture features PCIe Gen 4, third-generation NVLink, and NVIDIA RTX IO to accelerate data transfers and asset loading. The NVIDIA A40 and RTX A6000 GPUs leverage these technologies to enhance professional graphics, compute, and AI workloads.

This application relates to connecting electrical circuitry in a quantum computing system. The technology involves flexible cables comprising an electrically insulating flexible strip, internal metal striplines, and metallic grounding planes. These cables can be connected to rigid boards or mechanical stiffeners and may include integrated electronic components, such as filters or attenuators. The disclosed systems can be used in cryogenic environments, such as dilution refrigerators, to provide high-density, low-thermal-load signal lines for quantum processing units. Implementations include using compliant joints for electrical connections and employing composite materials with metallic particles for high-frequency absorption.

In the phase 3 LIVE-AIR trial, lenzilumab, a GM-CSF neutralizing monoclonal antibody, significantly improved survival without invasive mechanical ventilation (SWOV) in hospitalized COVID-19 patients compared to placebo. Post hoc analysis identified baseline C-reactive protein (CRP) as the strongest predictor of progression to invasive mechanical ventilation or death. Patients with baseline CRP <150 mg/L demonstrated the greatest clinical benefit from lenzilumab, including improved SWOV, reduced incidence of IMV, ECMO, or death, and increased ventilator-free days. Conversely, lenzilumab treatment showed similar SWOV results to placebo in patients with baseline CRP ≥150 mg/L. These findings suggest CRP may serve as a useful biomarker to guide lenzilumab therapy.

This cross-sectional study assessed the knowledge, attitude, and practice (KAP) of contraception among 217 female TV studies students at NTA TV College, Nigeria. Results showed relatively low levels of good knowledge (55.3%), attitude (47.5%), and practice (50.7%). Significant predictors of good knowledge included being a young adult; predictors of good attitude included being a diploma student, living off-campus, and having good knowledge; and predictors of good practice included being from the state's indigenous population and having engaged in sex. The study concludes there is an urgent need for improved advocacy, policies, and young people-friendly sexual and reproductive health services.

The TPS7H500x-SP series consists of radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency, peak current mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. These controllers support various topologies, including buck, flyback, forward, and push-pull, and can operate at switching frequencies up to 2 MHz. Key features include slope compensation to mitigate subharmonic oscillation, thermal shutdown at 175°C, and frequency compensation options (Type 2A or 2B). The devices are designed for input voltages between 4 V and 14 V and can be paired with external gate drivers for GaN or silicon power semiconductors.

Duane Boning introduces the MIT course "Control of Manufacturing Processes," which is delivered via video link between Cambridge and Singapore. The course focuses on managing manufacturing variation and quality through statistical process control, design of experiments, and process optimization. Students will use two required textbooks and engage in individual problem sets and a collaborative team project. The curriculum covers various technologies, including semiconductor fabrication and macroscopic processes, with an emphasis on understanding and modeling process physics and empirical data to improve robustness and minimize costs.

CJ Affiliate, also known as Commission Junction, is an established online advertising network that acts as a middleman between advertisers and publishers. The TMS320DM814x DaVinci Digital Media Processors utilize a switch fabric architecture consisting of L3 and L4 interconnects to manage communication between initiators and targets. The device features a Power, Reset, and Clock Management (PRCM) module that handles power domains, reset types (including POR, warm, and software resets), and clock generation via multiple PLLs. System clocking is supported through internal oscillators or external 1.8-V LVCMOS-compatible clock inputs. Additionally, the device includes various peripherals such as an Ethernet MAC Switch, an EDMA controller, and DCAN interfaces.

This study translated and cross-culturally adapted the Waterloo Footedness Questionnaire-Revised (WFQ-R) into Arabic (WFQ-Ar) for use in Saudi Arabia. Following a five-stage adaptation process, the WFQ-Ar was tested on 290 adult participants. Results demonstrated that the WFQ-Ar is a valid and reliable tool, showing excellent internal consistency (Cronbach’s α = 0.93), strong test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.94), and a single-factor structure. The tool is suitable for clinical and research purposes to assess footedness in Arabic-speaking populations.

Seasonal trading involves regular price patterns occurring at specific times. Silver exhibits seasonality, potentially due to industrial users placing orders at the start of the financial year. Historically, January and July are the best months to be long silver, while June and September are the worst. A backtested strategy involving holding silver from December to February and July to August has outperformed buy and hold since 2001, providing higher annual returns and significantly reduced maximum drawdowns.

Governor Gray Davis requested $500 million for additional power purchases for Southern California Edison and PG&E, which have begun repaying the state for previous purchases. The ADS868xW is a 16-bit SAR ADC that supports internal or external voltage references, selectable via the INTREF_DIS bit. The internal reference provides a nominal 4.096V and is temperature compensated from –40°C to +125°C. The device features an active-high alarm output for monitoring analog input thresholds and AVDD supply levels (typically 4.7V to 5.3V). Communication is handled through a multiSPI interface supporting various protocols, including standard SPI and source-synchronous modes. The device operates in RESET, ACQ, and CONV states, with programmable low-power NAP and power-down modes available to reduce consumption.

The disclosure provides methods for encoding digital video to allow a single bitstream to be used by both High Dynamic Range (HDR) and Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) systems. An encoder can receive an HDR master and a reference SDR master to find a color volume transform that converts HDR values into SDR values that substantially match the reference. The encoder then generates metadata identifying this transform, allowing HDR decoders to perform an inverse transform to reconstruct HDR values, while SDR decoders can use the SDR values directly or convert decoded HDR values into SDR values.

Hexane is a hydrocarbon solvent made from crude oil used to extract vegetable oils and as a cleaning agent in various industries. Analysis of cerebrospinal fluid tumor-derived DNA (CSF-tDNA) using CAPP-Seq in 24 patients with advanced lung cancer demonstrated higher variant allele fractions (VAFs) than plasma ctDNA and a sensitivity of 91.7% for diagnosing leptomeningeal disease (LMD), surpassing cytology (81.8%) and MRI (80.0%). This passage details various single-node and multi-node distributed patterns for building modular, reusable, and scalable containerized systems.

**Single-Node Patterns:**
* **Sidecar:** Augments an application container to add functionality.
* **Ambassador:** Brokers interactions between an application and the external world, such as routing traffic to sharded services, performing service discovery, or handling request splitting for experimentation.
* **Adapter:** Modifies an application's interface to ensure consistency, such as normalizing monitoring metrics, logging formats, or health checks.

**Multi-Node Patterns:**
* **Replicated Load-Balanced Services:** Uses multiple identical replicas and a load balancer to provide redundancy and horizontal scaling for stateless services.
* **Sharded Services:** Splits data across multiple machines to scale stateful services. This can include sharded caches, which improve memory utilization.
* **Scatter/Gather:** Achieves parallelism by distributing a single request to multiple leaf nodes and aggregating the results at a root node. To ensure reliability and scale, shards can be replicated.
* **Event-Driven/FaaS:** Uses granular, stateless functions that are automatically managed and scaled, though they require strong decoupling and external state storage.

This lecture discusses the ramifications of the collective Thomson scattering spectrum. The speaker explains how the spectral density function depends on electron and ion distribution functions and plasma response. Key topics include:

* **Modes of Scattering:** The spectrum is divided into high-frequency electron plasma waves and low-frequency ion acoustic waves. The interaction depends on the parameter $\alpha$ (the collective scattering parameter) and the ratio of phase velocity to thermal velocity.

* **Drift and Current:** Asymmetry in the ion acoustic peaks can be used to measure electron-ion drift velocity and local current.

This paper introduces a polynomial-time algorithm for many-to-one two-sided matching that addresses fairness for both participants and teams. The disclosure describes methods and devices for forming transistors, such as FinFETs, using metal gates and contact plugs. To address issues like poly depletion and high resistivity in scaled devices, the process utilizes cobalt or metal silicide layers. These metal-containing layers are deposited over metal nitride barrier layers (such as TiN) to form gate electrodes, source/drain contact plugs, or gate contact plugs. The cobalt-containing layers may consist of a cobalt silicide layer and a cobalt layer, which can be formed by adjusting deposition temperatures.

The TMS320DM814x DaVinci Digital Media Processors include a Spinlock module with 128 hardware semaphores for efficient resource locking and a Mailbox module for communication between the ARM Cortex-A8 and C674x DSP. The TILER includes an additional 4-GBytes of addressing range for frame buffer access. Device pins are highly multiplexed, with functions controlled by PINCNTLx registers, and include support for various interfaces such as GPMC, DDR, EMAC, HDMI, I2C, McASP, PCIe, SD, SPI, UART, USB, and video I/O. Boot configuration is determined by sampling BTMODE[15:0] pins at reset.
