Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull stated that China has an obligation to use its leverage to prevent North Korea from threatening regional stability following a failed missile test.

The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty50 rose for a fourth consecutive week, driven by healthy IT sector earnings, positive global cues, a normal monsoon forecast, and eased WPI inflation. However, gains were trimmed by higher crude oil prices, a weakening rupee, and selling in banking stocks due to a potential hawkish RBI stance. During the week, the Sensex rose 0.65 per cent and the Nifty50 rose 0.80 per cent.

During a sentencing hearing for former sports doctor Larry Nassar, Randall Margraves, the father of three victims, attempted to attack Nassar in a Michigan courtroom after a judge denied his request for private time with him. Margraves was restrained by deputies, and Judge Janice Cunningham declined to punish him for contempt.

An international team led by Harald Ebeling used the Hubble Space Telescope to discover eMACSJ1341-QG-1, a distant quiescent galaxy magnified 30 times by the massive galaxy cluster eMACSJ1341.9-2441. This extreme gravitational lensing allows scientists to study the stellar populations and evolution of a rare galaxy that has already stopped forming stars.

Larry Connors’ Multiple Days Up (MDU) and Multiple Days Down (MDD) strategy, detailed in his 2009 book *High Probability Trading*, focuses on ETF mean reversion. The strategy involves buying an ETF when it is above its 200-day moving average, below its 5-day moving average, and has dropped on 4 of the last 5 trading days, selling when it closes above its 5-day moving average. Testing on various ETFs and SPY/QQQ portfolios showed varying results, including a 1.82 profit factor for SPY and QQQ with a 2.4% CAGR.

Approximately 400 students at Brentwood high and middle schools were sent home Friday after a 70-pound boa constrictor escaped from a biology classroom enclosure. The snake, which was left to the school by a retired teacher, was found wrapped around pipes beneath the floor.

Freeport High School recognized several students for academic excellence on the second quarter honor roll, categorized into High Honors and Honors across grades 9 through 12. Additionally, North Yarmouth Academy students attained honor roll status during the first semester, with designations of Highest Honors, High Honors, and Honors for grades 5 through 12.

Virginia Chestnuts is a family-owned orchard in Nelson County, Virginia, operated by David and Kim Bryant. After planting blight-resistant Dunstan trees, the orchard has seen increasing harvests, including a 3,000-pound yield this year. The chestnuts are harvested from mid-September to late October, processed on-site, and sold raw or roasted to various consumers, including bakers and brewers.

On Independence Day, Noozhawk founder Bill Macfadyen highlights the importance of the First Amendment and requests support through the Hawks Club to fund their mission of providing high-quality reporting in Santa Barbara County.

Aston Villa defeated Burton Albion 3-2 at Villa Park, marking their sixth consecutive win. Scott Hogan, Albert Adomah, and Jack Grealish scored for Villa, while an Ahmed Elmohamady own goal and a Liam Boyce goal scored for the Brewers. The victory leaves Villa in third place, one point behind Derby County.

TI provides support through E2E™ forums and offers various technical resources "AS IS." The document notes that integrated circuits require ESD precautions to prevent damage. Revision A (May 2025) updated the status of ADS8685W and ADS8689W to Production Data. Mechanical and orderable information is subject to change, and TI disclaims warranties for its provided resources.

The discovery of a *Cifelliodon wahkarmoosuch* skull in eastern Utah suggests the Pangea split occurred 15 million years later than previously thought. This egg-laying, hair-covered species indicates that early mammal relatives were ecologically diverse and occupied various niches during the age of dinosaurs.

A Michigan State University study suggests that adaptive multi-paddock (AMP) grazing can potentially offset greenhouse gas emissions and act as a carbon sink, whereas feedlot systems are more land-efficient but produce higher emissions due to fertilizer use.

Mumbai Indians and Sunrisers Hyderabad face off following recent defeats. Mumbai Indians seek to recover from four losses in five games, while Sunrisers Hyderabad aim to bounce back from back-to-back losses. Sunrisers Hyderabad will feature Shikhar Dhawan, Mohammad Nabi, and Basil Thampi in their playing XI, while Billy Stanlake is ruled out of the tournament with a fractured finger.

The TPS7H500x-SP series consists of radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency, peak current mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. The devices feature an internal 1.23-V bandgap reference, a transconductance error amplifier, and three switching frequency modes: internal oscillator, external synchronization, and primary-secondary. Controllers offer programmable dead time, leading edge blank time, and duty cycle limits. Protection features include thermal shutdown, hiccup mode for overcurrent, and an external FAULT pin. The series supports various topologies, including buck, flyback, forward, push-pull, and full-bridge.

In the first round of Wimbledon, 24th seed Maria Sharapova lost to qualifier Vitalia Diatchenko after leading by a set and a break. This loss contributed to a record-breaking opening round where seven top-10 seeds departed, including Petra Kvitova and Caroline Garcia. Players cited unpredictable grass bounces, the transition from clay, and tournament pressure as potential factors for the unprecedented number of upsets.

Seamless Firmware Servicing (SFS) allows for the application of update packages to firmware, registers, or drivers. Customers must opt-in via BIOS and can choose to co-sign packages using an RSA public key to separate test and production environments. The security processor firmware authenticates these packages by verifying both customer and AMD signatures. SFS updates are non-persistent across reboots and require specific memory alignment and a deployment agent to communicate with the ASP via the TEE mailbox interface. While most updates have minimal performance impact, SEV firmware updates may require virtual machines to restart, though SEV/SNP machines can continue operating.

At Leander High School's 2017 prom, winner Keilany Solano surprised classmates by giving her crown and sash to nominee Abby Cano, a student with Down syndrome. Solano stated she felt Cano deserved it more.
Samsung Electronics is expected to report fourth-quarter 2016 operating income exceeding $6.5 billion, driven by robust memory chip sales, despite the Galaxy Note 7 discontinuation.

The third episode of Marvel’s *Inhumans*, titled “Divide and Conquer,” airs tonight at 9:00 p.m. ET on ABC. Viewers can stream the show via Sling TV or DirecTV Now, both of which offer free 7-day trials.

The United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit affirmed the district court's denial of a writ of habeas corpus for Rodney E. Nicholson. Nicholson argued that state courts violated his due process rights by ruling Darnell Phelps's hearsay confession inadmissible. The court held that Nicholson failed to show the state courts mechanistically rejected reliable evidence, noting the confession was inconsistent and its reliability could not be tested by cross-examination.

From June 1 to July 31, 2017, Helping Hands Hawaii’s Ready to Learn program is hosting its annual school supply drive to provide kits to low-income and homeless students. American Savings Bank branches will serve as collection sites from June 14 to July 14. Donations can be made via bank drop-offs, online, by mail, or in person. Students in grades K-12 must be recommended by a participating referral organization by June 23, 2017, to apply.

While millions of federal workers risk missing paychecks during an upcoming government shutdown, members of Congress will continue to receive pay. This is due to the US Constitution and the fact that lawmakers' salaries are funded via mandatory spending. Although Rep. Angie Craig introduced the "No Pay for Disarray" Act to dock pay during shutdowns, federal workers are guaranteed retroactive pay under the Government Employee Fair Treatment Act.

On Monday morning, 27-year-old Akayed Ullah injured himself and three others when a crude pipe bomb he was wearing exploded in a subway passageway near Times Square. Mayor Bill de Blasio and Police Commissioner James P. O'Neill labeled the incident an attempted terror attack. Officials stated Ullah was inspired by the Islamic State but had no direct contact with the group.

In a series of responses to Coach Sutter, the speaker discusses his coaching career, his brothers' six championships, and the challenges of winning and losing. He reflects on team identity, player performance in the Stanley Cup finals, and the importance of team response and sacrifice.

If Congress fails to fund the government, patients receiving hospital-level care at home through the Acute Hospital Care at Home initiative must be discharged or returned to hospitals by September 30, 2025.

The speaker expresses confidence in the coaching staff and the players, noting that the team is playing better through effort, execution, and playing within their strengths. The focus remains on staying in the moment, following established routines, and performing well in the upcoming game to continue earning their opportunities.

The speaker praises a player's speed, reach, and defensive focus, noting his ability to create chances. They also highlight Evgeni's health, energy, and urgency, while describing Zetterberg as a consistent and smart player.
On April 29, 2021, Amazon.com, Inc. announced its first quarter 2021 financial results via a press release.

Tesla delivered a record 497,099 vehicles in Q3 2025, a 7.4% year-over-year increase that exceeded analyst forecasts. This surge was driven by U.S. buyers rushing to utilize the $7,500 federal EV tax credit before its September 30 expiration. While U.S. sales rose due to incentives, Tesla's market share declined in Europe and the UK. Additionally, the company's energy division delivered a record 12.5 GWh of storage capacity.

The UC1825B-SP is a dual output controller with integrated drivers for push-pull topologies, supporting half bridge, full bridge, and current mode applications. Its sawtooth oscillator is governed by the RT and CT pins, with recommended RT values between 1 kΩ and 100 kΩ. The device design utilizes a transformer with specific turns ratios and primary inductance, alongside an output inductor and filter to manage ripple voltage. Layout considerations include using ground planes, minimizing trace lengths, and placing components like the RCD clamp and compensation circuitry close to the IC to manage EMI and stability.

Approximately 200 people gathered in Nottingham's market square for a vigil to support the family of 18-year-old Mariam Moustafa, who died following an attack. Speakers and attendees called for justice and an end to violence.

The National Beer Wholesalers Association launched DeliveringLocalJobs.com to highlight the 135,000 employees in the beer distribution industry. The website features videos and stories showcasing various roles and the industry's economic impact, including $70 billion in GDP and $13 billion in tax revenue.

After a performance decline in 2016, Cardinals quarterback Carson Palmer expressed optimism about the upcoming season. Despite his age and previous injuries, Palmer stated he feels physically great and prefers the team's current underdog role following their 7-8-1 record.

For the three months ended December 31, 2022, Microsoft Corporation reported total revenue of $52,747 million, compared to $51,728 million for the same period in 2021. Net income for the three months ended December 31, 2022, was $16,425 million, down from $18,765 million in 2021. The company recorded a $1.2 billion charge in the second quarter of fiscal year 2023, which included $800 million in employee severance expenses related to a decision to reduce its workforce by approximately 10,000 jobs. Additionally, Microsoft increased the estimated useful lives of its server and network equipment from four to six years, an accounting change that increased operating income by $945 million for the three months ended December 31, 2022.

The Bollinger Band Squeeze strategy is a breakout strategy based on the assumption that periods of low volatility, indicated by contracting Bollinger Bands, precede a breakout. While Bollinger Bands are used to measure volatility and identify overbought or oversold conditions, backtesting of this specific squeeze strategy across various assets and versions yielded no success and failed to beat buy-and-hold returns. The tool was developed by John Bollinger, who began developing the bands in the 1980s.

Due to accidental breaks and potential interference, the line to Fusan is interrupted. Following a request likely made by the King, the U.S.S. Petrel arrived in Chemulpo, and Commander Dayton is remaining in Seoul. Chinese ironclads and Japanese men-of-war are also present. Additionally, Confucian scholars have submitted a petition regarding disorderly people spreading heterodox talk, calling for authorities to arrest movement leaders and enforce law and order.

The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited reported its Q1 2018 financial results, highlighting a core return on average tangible common equity of 24.3% and a net interest margin of 3.05%. The company completed the acquisition of Deutsche Bank's Global Trust Solutions business and is working toward closing the acquisition of its banking operations in Cayman and the Channel Islands. Management noted that net interest income increased to $79.9 million and discussed strategies for managing asset sensitivity and expense targets.

Andy has been a key player who has stepped up physically during the playoffs. To succeed tonight, the team must control their emotions and maintain their composure despite loud opposing fans. Additionally, the arrival of another team in Newfoundland is expected to benefit the local economy and draw fans.

Pedro Russell, a co-founder of the education-focused search fund GPS Partners, is evaluating the acquisition of MedPro Institute, a vocational medical training school founded by Dr. Samantha Hill. While Russell identifies growth opportunities through increased advertising, he must determine how expanding student enrollment will affect the school's cost structure. Major expenses include rent, cleaning services, instructor salaries, career services, accreditation, supplies, insurance, internet, and electricity.

Hammerson directors rejected a preliminary, non-binding £4.88bn cash and share proposal from Klépierre SA, claiming the offer significantly undervalues the company. Despite the rejection, Hammerson's shares rose approximately 25% from their previous close. Hammerson remains committed to acquiring Intu Properties.

Sen. Cory Booker traveled to Alabama to campaign for Democratic Senate nominee Doug Jones. While the Jones campaign generally avoided national Democrats to prevent Republican attacks, Booker and other members of the Congressional Black Caucus visited the state to help mobilize African-American voters. Booker's visit also served as a way to lay political groundwork for the 2020 presidential election.

Despite unfortunate circumstances regarding Roli, the speaker views the current situation as an opportunity for whoever plays. While acknowledging a difficult year and a bad play that resulted in a lost game, the speaker emphasizes maintaining confidence, staying focused, and preparing for the Stanley Cup Finals.

The Second Circuit Court of Appeals reversed a Board of Tax Appeals decision regarding a deficiency determined by the Commissioner of Internal Revenue. The dispute concerned whether a 1931 preferred stock dividend paid upon common stock was exempt from taxation under section 115 (f) of the Revenue Act of 1928. The court held that the statute's exemption for "stock dividends" applied to the preferred stock distributed to the petitioner. Additionally, the court declined to support the Commissioner's argument regarding the taxability of the redemption of previously received shares, as the issue was not decided by the Board of Tax Appeals.
Columnist Dan Le Batard reported that the Miami Heat organization believed LeBron James "checked out" during the 2014 NBA Finals because he knew he was leaving the team.

Bitcoin rose approximately 2% to $123,874 on Friday, nearing its all-time high as the U.S. government shutdown entered its third day. Investors are utilizing the cryptocurrency as a hedge against political and economic tensions.

The court held that while a creditor's failure to present a claim against an estate within the statutory period does not extinguish the debt, it does remove the remedy for its recovery. Consequently, an insolvent estate cannot use a court of equity to compel a creditor to surrender securities used to secure the debt, as the maxim "he who seeks equity must do equity" requires the debt to be paid. The judgment was reversed, and the demurrer to the complaint was sustained.

Google and YouTube terminated services for the neo-Nazi website Daily Stormer due to policy violations regarding hate speech and inciting violence. This followed GoDaddy's decision to require the site to find a new host after it ridiculed a woman killed during a white nationalist rally. Other companies, including Facebook and Tucows, have also taken actions to distance themselves from the site.

Matthew James Phelps is being held without bail on first-degree murder charges after calling 911 on September 1, claiming he killed his wife, Lauren, in a medicated stupor after taking Coricidin cough medicine. Investigators found red-stained bedding and an empty medicine box at the scene.

Embodiments disclose bonded optical devices for use in wearable electronics, such as augmented reality glasses. The devices comprise optical elements, such as monochromatic LED arrays, directly or hybrid bonded without adhesive to a carrier, such as a processor die with active circuitry for pixel control. These elements can be arranged to couple light into an optical pathway, like a waveguide, to transmit a superimposed polychromatic image to a user. The technology enables fine pixel pitches, potentially less than 5 microns, and can utilize direct bonding techniques to connect dielectric surfaces and conductive contact pads.

Transport Cabinet Secretary James Macharia attributed the motorbike industry's disorganization to poor enforcement of existing regulations by bodies like the NTSA. To address this, the ministry is collaborating with county transport committees and the traffic department to implement rules. Meanwhile, Ruiru MP Simon King'ara proposed establishing a dedicated motorbike safety authority and suggested benchmarking against Rwanda.
Due to a government shutdown and lapse in appropriations, the IRS is furloughing approximately 34,000 workers. About 39,870 employees, or 53.6% of the workforce, will remain on the job.

The NVIDIA GA10x Ampere architecture provides up to 2x performance improvements in programmable shading, ray tracing, and AI compared to the Turing architecture. Key advancements include second-generation RT Cores that double ray/triangle intersection rates and support hardware-accelerated motion blur, and third-generation Tensor Cores featuring fine-grained structured sparsity for up to 2x throughput. The architecture also introduces GDDR6X memory with PAM4 signaling, the RTX IO suite for rapid GPU-based asset loading, and support for 8K resolution and HDMI 2.1.

This study analyzes public financing instruments for European cleantech start-ups and SMEs, including loan, equity, grant, and guarantee options. Managed by bodies like the EIB and EIF, these instruments support sectors such as renewable energy and smart cities through direct funding or intermediaries. The report benchmarks instruments based on metrics like portfolio size, success rates, and technology readiness levels, while noting that many provide additional business support services.

Following a calamity in Johnstown and near Williamsport, Pennsylvania, the speaker proposes three relief measures: collecting food for immediate distribution, gathering clothing and bedding, and appointing a committee to collect money for long-term reconstruction.

The Tennessee National Wildlife Refuge headquarters and Visitor Center will close on August 21st for the solar eclipse. The public is directed to Cross Creeks National Wildlife Refuge to view the eclipse, where staff will assist with parking and information. Visitors may view the eclipse near the Visitor Center or along the wildlife viewing road. Special glasses, t-shirts, and water will be sold to benefit Friends of Cross Creeks NWR, and visitors are encouraged to bring picnics.

The Court of Appeal of Louisiana, Fourth Circuit, affirmed the conviction and ten-year sentence of William Brock for molestation of a juvenile. Brock appealed on the grounds of insufficient evidence and an unconstitutionally excessive sentence. The court found that the evidence, including medical testimony and witness accounts, supported the jury's conclusion that Brock committed the offense. Additionally, the court determined the sentence was not excessive and that the trial court properly considered aggravating and mitigating factors.

This study used a mixed-method design to examine the attitudes of 190 Bayburt University Faculty of Education students toward the Research Methods in Education (RME) course. Quantitative results indicated that student attitudes did not differ significantly by department but showed significant differences based on grade level, with fourth-year students differing from first-year students. Qualitative findings revealed that 90% of participants found the course necessary for scientific research and professional development, though 60% noted that the course duration was insufficient. The study suggests that making RME a compulsory course and increasing its duration or credits could improve student attitudes.

Centrica has an 8.6% dividend yield following a 35% stock price drop, though regulatory uncertainty and business model changes persist. Meanwhile, Volution reported an 11.6% revenue rise and acquired Simx Limited, suggesting potential for inflation-beating dividend growth despite a current 2.2% yield.

In his final press conference, the President expressed appreciation for the press corps and addressed several topics. He stated he would only request the remaining $350 billion in bail money if President-elect Obama specifically asked him to do so. Regarding the Gaza conflict, he called for a sustainable cease-fire and noted Israel's right to defend itself. On security, he identified attacks on the homeland as the most urgent threat and noted ongoing concerns regarding North Korea and Iran.

The President discussed the Republican Party, suggesting it must remain compassionate and broad-minded. Reflecting on his presidency, he acknowledged mistakes such as the "Mission Accomplished" rhetoric and the timing of Social Security discussions, while defending his economic and Iraq policies. He concluded by wishing President-elect Obama well, emphasizing the importance of respectful discourse in Washington.

This cross-sectional survey of 133 occupational therapy students explored the mentorship needs of those from historically underrepresented groups. Results indicated that current mentorship is insufficient for these students, who expressed a desire for mentors demonstrating cultural humility, empathy, and anti-racism allyship to help navigate workplace discrimination and microaggressions. Students prioritized mentor qualities such as personality, expertise, and availability, with many seeking mentors who share their ethnic or cultural backgrounds. The study suggests that occupational therapy programs should implement culturally sensitive, hybrid mentorship models and provide structured training for mentors to enhance equity, inclusion, and professional resilience.

The Colorado Supreme Court granted a writ of prohibition against a district court, ruling that the trial court lacked jurisdiction over defendants. The case involved a dispute over whether defendants, who had moved to California, were still Colorado residents for the purpose of service of process under Rule 4 (f) (1) R.C.P. Colo. The court determined that the defendants' intention to abandon Colorado residency was evidenced by their employment, purchase of property, and registration to vote in California. Consequently, the trial court's denial of the motion to quash service was erroneous.

European markets reached record highs, led by gains in steel and banking sectors. Steel stocks rose following a European Commission proposal to cut tariff-free import quotas, while banking shares gained due to stable bond yields. These increases helped offset declines in auto stocks, such as BMW. Global risk appetite grew on expectations of U.S. Federal Reserve monetary easing, driving gold prices above $4,000 per ounce.

On Tuesday, the Sensex and Nifty closed marginally lower. Despite the flat market, AIA Engineering, Alkem Laboratories, KEC International, Exide Industries, and Kalpataru Power Transmission all hit new 52-week highs during trading.

Confirmed matches for Royal Rumble 2017 include AJ Styles vs. John Cena for the WWE Championship, Kevin Owens vs. Roman Reigns for the WWE Universal Championship, and a 30-man Royal Rumble match featuring Goldberg and Brock Lesnar.

Bath Rugby fans have faced significant travel disruptions following a Champions Cup match in Toulon. Wintry weather, flight cancellations, and logistical errors have forced supporters to use alternative routes, such as trains or connecting flights through various European cities, to return to the UK.

Shares of U.S. rare earth and critical mineral miners surged after China tightened export restrictions on products containing rare earths and required licenses for certain technologies. This move comes ahead of an expected meeting between President Xi Jinping and President Donald Trump. The Trump administration has previously taken equity stakes in miners to build a domestic supply chain.

Two Boeing 737 MAX 8 crashes—Lion Air Flight 610 in October 2018 and Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 in March 2019—resulted in 346 fatalities. Investigations identified the Maneuvering Characteristics Augmentation System (MCAS), designed to prevent stalls by automatically pushing the aircraft's nose down, as a central factor. MCAS relied on a single angle-of-attack sensor, creating a single point of failure. Boeing faced scrutiny for a compressed development timeline intended to compete with Airbus, for failing to adequately disclose MCAS changes to the FAA, and for seeking to minimize pilot simulator training. Following the accidents, the 737 MAX was grounded for 21 months, leading to significant financial losses and leadership changes at Boeing.

After seven months out of action, the speaker returned to competitive hockey following selection for the Russian Olympic team and a contract match by the Detroit Red Wings. After negotiations and a period of mental exhaustion, the speaker returned to play for Detroit. The speaker also noted the presence of Vladi in the stands and described an inspirational speech by Scotty Bowman.

This study introduces Hybrid CA with Refinement (HCAR), a three-phase framework designed to address over-fitting in Constraint Acquisition (CA), particularly regarding global constraints. 

1. **Passive Learning:** Generates initial candidate global constraints ($B_{globals}$) from positive examples and a pruned set of fixed-arity constraints ($B_{fixed}$).
2. **Query-Driven Interactive Refinement:** The core phase that uses machine learning-based confidence scores and Bayesian updates to vet global candidates via oracle queries. It includes a **Subset Exploration** mechanism to recover valid sub-constraints from rejected over-fitted ones and an adaptive query budget management system.
3. **Active Learning:** Completes the model by learning remaining fixed-arity constraints.

Empirical validation shows the framework achieves high accuracy and coverage from limited examples with manageable query complexity.

This study investigated research expectations for U.S. mathematics education faculty, focusing on how they vary by institution type (R1, R2, or other), department type (education or mathematics), and research time commitment. Findings indicate that R1 faculty face higher publication expectations and are more likely to be required to pursue external funding and give presentations. R2 faculty are more likely to have publication expectations explicitly stated in written documents. While research journal articles are universally highly valued, expectations for other scholarly activities and publication types differ across demographic groups.

This study investigates the orbital Edelstein effect (OEE) and spin Edelstein effect (SEE) in doped monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) under a perpendicular gate field. Using a 5×5 tight-binding Hamiltonian model fitted to density functional theory data, the researchers found that breaking mirror symmetry induces chiral spin and orbital textures. In electron-doped systems, the OEE is significantly larger than the SEE. In hole-doped systems, the response is dominated by the $\Gamma$ valley; while the OEE is enhanced by the additive nature of its subbands, the SEE is diminished by a cancellation effect. The study demonstrates that compressive strain can significantly enhance the Edelstein response in hole-doped TMDs by shifting the $\Gamma$ valley to the valence band top. Overall, the calculated Edelstein susceptibilities in these materials are one to two orders of magnitude larger than those reported in other systems.

Developed by Chester Keltner in the 1960s, the Keltner Channel is a technical analysis tool used to assess volatility and potential price trends. It consists of a central moving average (typically an EMA) and two bands calculated by adding and subtracting a multiple of the Average True Range (ATR) from that middle line. Unlike Bollinger Bands, which use standard deviation, Keltner Channels use ATR to dynamically adjust to market volatility. Traders use these channels to identify support and resistance, overbought or oversold conditions, and potential entry or exit points for strategies such as mean reversion, momentum, or scalping.

On December 12, 2016, NVIDIA Corporation entered into a Termination Agreement with Goldman, Sachs & Co. to terminate 63,259,180.62 outstanding warrants. In exchange, NVIDIA will deliver shares of Common Stock to Goldman, with the amount determined by the stock's daily volume-weighted average price between December 13, 2016, and January 31, 2017.

While government shutdowns historically have had minimal economic impact, this instance could differ due to President Trump's threat to make some federal furloughs permanent. Additionally, a prolonged shutdown could delay key economic data releases, potentially affecting Federal Reserve decisions and Social Security cost-of-living adjustments.

The Netflix documentary “Unknown Number: The High School Catfish” follows a harassment mystery in Beal City, Michigan, involving students Lauryn Licari and Owen McKenny. After local investigations failed to identify the sender of graphic and threatening text messages, the FBI became involved, utilizing forensic examinations of mobile devices and cellular provider records. The author uses the documentary to discuss the risks of cellphone usage and notes that Oklahoma has passed a "bell to bell" policy prohibiting electronic devices in schools for the 2025-2026 school year.

The Bank of England has allocated £5.085 billion in its six-month indexed long-term repo operation, the highest amount since March 2020. This increase reflects rising bank demand for central bank liquidity as the BoE shifts away from excess reserves and unwinds its quantitative easing programme.

Developed by Richard Fabian in the 1960s, the Fabian Market Timing Model is a quantitative, long-term trend-following strategy for the S&P 500. It uses 39-week moving averages of the S&P 500, the Dow Jones Industrial Average, and the utilities sector to generate signals. While historical backtest returns are comparable to buy-and-hold, the strategy's primary advantage is low volatility and maximum drawdown.

A House budget subcommittee advanced a bill to address South Carolina's $24 billion pension gap by increasing employee and employer contributions. Additionally, a bill allowing out-of-state concealed weapons permit holders to carry in the state advanced to the House floor, and the Senate passed a measure for Coastal Carolina University championship license plates.
Chelsea will face Barcelona in the Champions League last-16. Chelsea finished second in Group C, while Barcelona won Group D. The first legs are scheduled for February, with the second legs in March.

Lorna Gibson discusses modeling trabecular bone and osteoporosis using Voronoi honeycombs. She explains that while randomness in structure does not significantly alter the elastic modulus, it does affect strength due to stress and strain distributions. Using finite element analysis, she demonstrates that removing struts (resorption) causes a more substantial loss in modulus and strength than merely thinning them.

The lecture also covers the use of biocompatible metal foams (such as titanium or tantalum) as potential bone substitute coatings or implants. Additionally, Gibson explores evolutionary studies, noting that bone structure reflects mechanical loads. She cites a study of the *Oreopithecus bambolii* fossil, where trabecular architecture in the ilium suggested bipedalism based on similarities to human bone patterns.

Tesla, Inc. reported for the quarter ended September 30, 2021, total revenues of $13,757 million, compared to $8,771 million for the same period in 2020. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $1,618 million for the three months ended September 30, 2021, up from $331 million in 2020. As of September 30, 2021, total assets were $57,834 million and total liabilities were $29,340 million. The company operates in two segments: automotive and energy generation and storage.

This interdisciplinary qualitative study explores how dialogic pedagogy can be implemented in classroom practices to support Bildung and democratic citizenship. Using a deductive approach and narrative analysis, the researchers examine two cases: a pre-service music teacher education choir project and an upper-primary mathematics classroom discussion. The study utilizes theoretical frameworks including epistemological and ontological dialogue, musicking, and mathematizing to analyze how teachers facilitate student participation. Findings suggest that when teachers engage as whole persons—sharing vulnerability and embracing uncertainty—they create a didactic contract that supports both subject-specific knowledge and the personal development of students.

The speaker outlines conditions for the United States to join a league for peace, stating that the nation will contribute its authority to guarantee global peace and justice. He argues that a lasting peace requires an organized community of power rather than a balance of power, and must be a "peace without victory" based on equality rather than terms imposed upon a vanquished foe.

British Transport Police are investigating the sexual assault of a 19-year-old woman on a train near Highbridge and Burnham on April 8. Officers are appealing for witnesses or information regarding the group involved.

The lecture explores the properties and calculation of gravitational radiation within linearized Einstein field equations. The instructor explains that the 10 degrees of freedom in a space-time perturbation can be decomposed into six gauge-invariant functions and four gauge degrees of freedom. The two gauge-invariant radiative degrees of freedom correspond to the polarizations of gravitational waves: "plus" and "cross" polarizations.

The lecture demonstrates that while a single body in free fall follows a geodesic and may appear unaccelerated in certain coordinate systems, the effect of gravitational waves can be measured by observing the relative motion (geodesic deviation) of two nearby bodies or by measuring variations in the arrival time of light pulses.

Finally, the instructor derives the quadrupole formula, which allows for the calculation of the transverse-traceless metric perturbation ($h_{ij}^{TT}$) from a given source by using the second time derivative of the source's quadrupole moment.

Research published in The FASEB Journal identifies TRPM8 and TRPP3 receptors as potential therapeutic targets to increase metabolism-boosting brown adipose tissue. By studying human bone marrow stem cells and subcutaneous belly fat cells, scientists found that stimulating TRPM8 supports browning, while eliminating TRPP3 prevents brown fat formation. This discovery may aid in treating obesity and diabetes.

To manage winter parking congestion at Kensington Park, the Whangarei District Council advises drivers to plan ahead, carpool, or drop players off. The Council uses warning fliers before issuing tickets for infractions such as blocking driveways, obstructing footpaths, or damaging verges.

Following detected discrepancies in question papers and answer keys, the Jammu and Kashmir Public Service Commission has kept the 2016 Combined Competitive (Preliminary) Examination results in abeyance and withdrawn the main examination notification. The Commission will refer all 23 subjects to independent experts for re-evaluation.

The disclosed fluid end comprises multiple side-by-side fluid end sections, each featuring a single horizontally positioned housing with a horizontal bore. This design eliminates the intersecting vertical bores and internal chambers found in traditional fluid ends to reduce manufacturing costs and stress points. Each housing is attached to a connect plate via a fastening system and stay rods.

Fluid is routed through the housing using a fluid routing plug installed within the horizontal bore. The plug features a suction side with a blind bore and first fluid passages, and a discharge side with second fluid passages. The plug facilitates the movement of fluid between an upper and lower intake manifold and a discharge manifold via suction and discharge valves. The fluid routing plug's intermediate surface includes first and second bevels and sealing surfaces designed to engage with first and second seals installed in grooves within the housing. These components are configured to manage pressure fluctuations, accommodate expansion, and protect the housing from erosion by minimizing open volume within the seal grooves.

The present disclosure relates to applying scheduling offsets for power saving in next-generation wireless networks. To address issues in New Radio (NR) where Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request (HARQ) operations may not consider power saving states, the disclosure provides methods for a user equipment (UE) to receive a power saving signal. This signal includes a minimum applicable K ($K_{0min}$) indicating a minimum scheduling offset restriction between a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) and a physical downlink shared channel (PDSCH). The UE determines an application delay based on a predefined value and applies the minimum scheduling offset restriction after that delay. The disclosure also covers mechanisms for HARQ feedback for power saving signals, including using a bit in the HARQ codebook to acknowledge receipt, and enhancements for default beam selection rules when a UE is in a power saving state.

Erik Demaine discusses fusion trees, a static integer data structure designed to achieve $\log_w n$ predecessor and successor queries on a word RAM. The structure utilizes "sketching" to compress $w$-bit integers into smaller bit strings that preserve order, allowing for parallel comparisons. 

Key techniques include:
* **Approximate Sketching:** Using integer multiplication to extract and compress "important" bits into a predictable, small interval.
* **Parallel Comparison:** Using multiplication and subtraction to compare a query against multiple sketches simultaneously in constant time.
* **De-sketchification:** A process to correct errors when a query's sketch does not accurately reflect its position among the original keys.
* **Most Significant Set Bit:** A constant-time operation achieved through recursive clustering, masking, and sketching to identify the leftmost 1 bit.

While the original version by Fredman and Willard is static and requires polynomial preprocessing, various dynamic versions exist using hashing or exponential search trees.

A study in North-East Tanzania investigated the relationship between malaria and malnutrition among school-age children using a cross-sectional survey and a randomized controlled trial. Baseline findings showed a 27% malaria prevalence, with 23% of children aged ≤10 years being underweight, 21% stunted, and 28% thin. Malaria was significantly associated with stunting (AOR=1.78) and thinness (AOR=1.37), while low socioeconomic status was associated with being underweight (AOR=1.50). The trial evaluated the impact of intermittent preventive therapy using dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine (DP) and artesunate-amodiaquine (ASAQ); however, these treatments did not significantly affect changes in mean weight, height, or BMI compared to the control group. The authors conclude that public health agencies should implement integrated approaches that combine malaria control with nutritional programs.

A longitudinal study of 691 participants in India compared the immunogenicity of Covishield (adenovirus vectored) and Covaxin (inactivated) vaccines across seronegative and seropositive groups. While Covaxin elicited nucleocapsid antibodies, its spike-binding and neutralizing responses were generally lower than those of Covishield.

This application relates to methods and apparatuses for encoding and decoding video signals to improve intra-prediction and inter-prediction efficiency. Key technical solutions include:

* **Inter-prediction:** Improving efficiency by using a weight prediction parameter (comprising multiplication and addition parameters) derived via regression analysis or reconstructed pixels adjacent to the current or reference blocks. The system can merge motion information and weight parameters with neighbor blocks or encode them via bitstreams.
* **Motion Vector Precision:** Adjusting motion vector precision based on reconstructed pixels adjacent to the current block.
* **Intra-prediction:** Enhancing efficiency by correcting prediction samples using coefficients derived from blocks with similar features (determined by reconstructed pixel area standard deviation) and effectively encoding intra-prediction modes through candidate mode generation or difference values.
* **Sub-block Prediction:** Improving efficiency by dividing current blocks into multiple sub-blocks for individual prediction.

To address viewpoint-dependent variability in monocular 3D pose estimation, this work introduces 3DPCNet, a compact, estimator-agnostic module that maps camera-centered 3D skeletons to a fixed, body-centered canonical frame. The architecture utilizes a hybrid encoder with parallel graph convolutional and transformer branches, fused via a gated cross-attention mechanism, to predict a continuous 6D global rotation and an optional residual correction. Evaluated on the MM-Fi dataset, 3DPCNet significantly reduced rotation error and positional error compared to a geometric baseline. Furthermore, testing on the TotalCapture dataset demonstrated that the rectified poses produce kinematic acceleration signals that more closely resemble ground-truth IMU data, particularly under challenging viewpoints.

The disclosed embodiments relate to managing indexed data within a computing environment, specifically optimizing index file size based on storage conditions. The system, exemplified by the SPLUNK® ENTERPRISE platform, collects, indexes, and searches machine-generated data (events) using a late-binding schema. This approach allows for flexible, search-time field extraction via rules like regular expressions. The architecture includes forwarders for data intake, indexers for parsing and storage, and search heads for query processing. To improve performance, the system employs acceleration techniques such as parallel processing, keyword indexing, high-performance analytics stores (summarization tables), and report generation acceleration. Additionally, specialized applications provide security monitoring and data center visibility.

The IRS has announced higher federal income tax brackets and standard deductions for 2026 to adjust for inflation. The standard deduction will increase to $32,200 for married couples filing jointly and $16,100 for single taxpayers. Changes also include adjustments to long-term capital gains brackets, the estate and gift tax exemption, and earned income tax credit eligibility.

The SEV-ES Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) defines the protocol for communication between guests and hypervisors. The GHCB contains fields for protocol versioning, SEV page table encryption bit numbers, and various request/response mechanisms for CPUID, page state changes, and AP creation. For SEV-SNP guests, the protocol includes specific requirements for GHCB GPA registration, SNP guest requests, and the use of a doorbell page for restricted injection of interrupts and non-maskable events. The doorbell page facilitates emulated APIC behavior, allowing the hypervisor to signal pending events and the guest to perform end-of-interrupt (EOI) cycles.

Egyptian archaeologists unveiled the Old Kingdom tomb of Hetpet, a priestess to the goddess Hathor, on the Giza plateau. The Fifth Dynasty tomb features well-preserved wall paintings depicting hunting, fishing, and offerings, alongside rare scenes of monkeys.

SOS full court pressure scenarios, including "shadow" and "Blitz" pressures, aim to disrupt offensive tempo, create turnovers, and wear down opponents. Shadow actions involve a second defender playing behind the on-ball defender, while Blitz pressures aggressively deny first passing lanes. Effectiveness depends on executing SOS defensive fundamentals, such as forcing the ball away from the middle. If shadow players lose position or deep outlet passes are made, teams revert to basic half-court defense.

Following Nataliya Mykolska’s visit to London, the UK and Ukraine discussed growing trade and investment links post-Brexit. Both nations aim to avoid trade disruption by ensuring the continuity of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement and its Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement during the UK-EU Implementation Period.

Amber Enterprises has received Sebi's approval to raise approximately Rs 555 crore through an IPO, consisting of a Rs 450 crore fresh issue and Rs 105 crore in promoter share sales. The Gurugram-based manufacturer plans to use the proceeds for loan repayments and general corporate purposes.

Research using human postmortem samples and rhesus macaques found that subjects with substance use disorder (SUD) exhibit increased numerical densities of perineuronal nets (PNNs) in various hippocampal subregions, including CA1. This increase is accompanied by decreased expression of extracellular matrix (ECM) proteolytic genes (Mmp9 and Ctss), increased expression of the CSPG synthesis molecule Chsy1, and altered synaptic markers like Vamp2. In contrast, subjects with major depressive disorder (MDD) showed generally opposite effects, such as decreased PNN densities. These findings suggest that enhanced PNN composition may stabilize reward-associated memories in SUD, potentially serving as a therapeutic target for context-induced relapse.

The invention provides systems and methods for the localization and classification of abnormalities, such as lesions or bleeding, in medical images. One embodiment utilizes a multi-task network comprising a jointly trained localization network and a classification network. Another embodiment detects abnormalities by comparing an input medical image to a synthesized normal image generated by a trained generative adversarial network (GAN) from incomplete images. Additionally, the invention includes methods for training deep learning models using multi-site datasets through a two-stage process of training and deployment-stage optimization, and a regression network architecture for determining lesion scores.

The speaker noted that the team failed to play their game and did not perform at their potential. They accepted a non-goal ruling by officials and stated the team must move on and focus on the next game.

Trump tweeted about lives devastated by the "Russia Collusion Witch Hunt," though it was unclear whom he meant. While some aides have left the White House, most departed due to administration infighting rather than the investigation. Rudy Giuliani stated that while they are comfortable regarding collusion, he is less comfortable regarding potential obstruction of justice. Meanwhile, Senator Marco Rubio defended the FBI's investigation into foreign interference, and Trump falsely claimed a New York Times source was non-existent.

A first-year review of the University of Virginia Health System's thoracic Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) program shows it reduced morphine equivalent use by 59–74 percent, decreased median hospital stays by two days, and saved over $1.3 million. The program, which enrolled 139 patients, improved clinical outcomes without increasing surgical complications or readmissions.

Two Lashkar-e-Jhangvi militants escaped from the Central Jail's judicial complex, leading to the suspension of over a dozen officials and a request to register a case against them. Separately, a robber named Ali Asghar was killed during a police exchange of fire following an attempted carjacking in DHA, while Karachi police arrested 15 outlaws in various raids.

French President Emmanuel Macron's maiden visit to Nigeria focused on security cooperation, intelligence sharing regarding the G-5 Sahel and Boko Haram, and a reforestation project in Ogun State. Macron noted that addressing terrorism requires understanding why youth join such groups and stated Nigeria is responsible for violence from Fulani herdsmen. Meanwhile, South Africa's Times Live reported on child trafficking in Gabon, highlighting the exploitation of children from Benin and Mali.

USD/JPY dropped over 2.0% following a weak NFP report and the dismissal of the Bureau of Labor Statistics’ CEO. The Bank of England faces a potential 25 basis-point rate cut amid slowing UK economic momentum. GBP/USD seeks direction near May's floor, while BTC/USD has declined alongside equities, testing key support levels.

A Joseph Rowntree Foundation study reveals that families need £40,000 annually for a decent standard of living, with single people requiring £18,400. To address this, the author suggests reducing childcare and housing costs through deregulation, increasing personal tax allowances, and pursuing economic growth.

Culpeper defeated Courtland 2-1 in a nondistrict baseball game, largely due to Courtland's seven errors. Despite stellar complete-game pitching from Alex Kobersteen and Jake Dudley, defensive miscues allowed Culpeper to score both unearned runs.

The Department of Education is halting two Obama-era rules scheduled for July 1 to create committees for review and improvement. The rules involve "gainful employment" standards for certain colleges and a "Borrower Defense to Repayment" process for defrauded students. While the department will continue processing 16,000 existing claims, critics and Democratic lawmakers argue the delay will harm students, while some colleges have sued to block the rules.

The November 30, 2000, VentureWire newsletter reports several business developments, including 724 Solutions' agreement to acquire Tantau Software for approximately $375 million and El Dorado Ventures' formation of a $250 million fund. Other news includes MaMaMedia reducing its staff to 15 employees, iVMG appointing Samer Salameh as CEO, and various companies securing new funding rounds, such as Medschool.com ($26 million) and E2O Communications ($38.5 million). Additionally, Blackboard announced plans to acquire several platforms from iCollege, and Hyperion Partners reported raising $73 million of a $100 million fund.

Etisalat Nigeria has not yet reached a deal with 13 local banks to restructure a $1.2 billion loan following a missed payment. Nigerian regulators and banks are pursuing a default deal instead of receivership to avoid a wider debt crisis.

A goal kick is taken from the goal area after an attacking player kicks the ball over the defenders' end line. The objective is to retain possession and create an attack. Opposing players must remain outside the penalty area until the ball is in play. For younger players, "build-out lines" are used to allow defenders to retreat, facilitating successful kicks. As players age, tactical options increase, involving various target players and midfielders. In adult play, the goalkeeper typically takes the kick. Under Law 16, a goal kick is a direct restart, meaning a goal can be scored directly against the opponent.

Greece's central bank chief urged Athens and foreign lenders to complete the country's bailout review by the end of February to avoid undermining the economy's expected recovery and increasing uncertainty.

Endorsed by the Finance Ministry, Project Sashakat utilizes a five-pronged strategy to accelerate non-performing asset resolution. The plan involves using asset management companies for loans exceeding Rs 500 crore and steering committees for loans up to Rs 50 crore via a 90-day template approach. The strategy includes inter-creditor arrangements, frameworks to attract foreign capital, and an asset trading platform, but does not recommend a "bad bank."

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced an agreement to build a Qatari Emiri Air Force facility at Mountain Home Air Force Base in Idaho. The facility will host Qatari F-15s and pilots to train with American military personnel to enhance interoperability and partnership.

Researchers are launching an experiment to investigate how providing new mothers with supplemental, untaxed monthly income affects the brain and emotional development of babies and toddlers during their first three years.

This prospective, descriptive cross-sectional study analyzed 165 scorpion sting patients admitted to Tesseney Community Hospital in Eritrea from June 2019 to May 2020. The study found a case fatality rate of 4.8%, with severity being higher in children under 15 years old. Common clinical manifestations included localized pain, sweating, and vomiting. Most stings occurred at night, primarily on the feet, with black scorpions being the most frequently identified. The study suggests that preventive educational programs and improved access to essential medications, such as prazosin, are necessary to reduce mortality and morbidity in the region.

The random walk theory, popularized by Burton Gordon Malkiel, posits that stock prices move unpredictably and independently of historical data, making technical or fundamental analysis futile. This theory assumes a 50% probability of a price increase or decrease, suggesting that market movements are driven by random events. Consequently, the random walk trading strategy emphasizes risk diversification through broad market index funds or diversified portfolios rather than attempting to time the market. While the random walk theory assumes market irrationality and the efficient market hypothesis (EMH) assumes market efficiency, both conclude that consistently outperforming the market is nearly impossible and support passive investing.

StarCompliance provides technology to help firms manage complex global and local regulations. As regulatory oversight intensifies and penalties rise, the company offers an Enterprise platform for conflict management, incident tracking, and accountability to transform compliance into a strategic advantage.

U.S. policy has consistently protected American interests in Hawaii and considered annexation as a contingency. Historical attempts and discussions regarding annexation occurred in 1850, 1851, 1854, 1867, 1868, 1871, and 1873. Since the 1875 reciprocity treaty, administrations have defended U.S. commercial rights and supported the Hawaiian Government. Official oversight began in 1820 with the appointment of a commerce and seamen agent.

Official fuel economy figures, based on the outdated New European Driving Cycle (NEDC), are often unrealistic due to loopholes like removing car components, using eco modes, and lacking sustained motorway driving. To provide more accurate data, Which? uses the tougher Worldwide-harmonised Light vehicles Test Procedure (WLTP) in a controlled lab setting. Their testing includes realistic conditions, such as using air conditioning and standard driving modes, and incorporates motorway-driving cycles and real-road PEMS testing to prevent manufacturers from manipulating emissions data.

Originating from South America, anthuriums feature heart-shaped blossoms in red, pink, or white and act as natural filters for ammonia and xylene. They require bright, indirect light, dampness, and temperatures between 18°C and 21°C. While their sap and leaves may cause allergies, they can be maintained by spraying leaves in winter and repotting annually or biennially.

Using a quasi-experimental approach, this study investigates how different teaching modalities—in-person, hybrid, and online—impact COVID-19 cases and deaths in counties surrounding colleges. The research finds that college reopening, particularly through in-person teaching, increases COVID-19 cases and deaths over time.

Post-war assets include satisfying Bulgarian claims, utilizing military successes in Turkey, and leveraging German colonial exclusions. The Russian revolution poses a threat to German domination through anti-capitalism, religious antagonism, and nationalism. While the Vatican offers potential assistance, American resources ensure a military victory. Additionally, intangibles like the longing for peace, distrust of old diplomacy, and hope for a league of nations favor the Allies, while Germany may shift policy toward the east to exploit Russian opportunities.

President Truman announced Germany's unconditional surrender to the United Nations, noting that while Europe is freed, the war in the East against Japan continues. He called for continued work to finish the war and build an abiding peace, proclaiming May 13, 1945, a day of prayer to thank God and honor those who died.
On October 2, 2022, Tesla, Inc. published a press release incorporated into this Form 8-K under Items 2.02 and 7.01.

Navient Cp Cmn (NASDAQ:NAVI) shares rose 2.27% to a close of $13.51. Nine analysts project a 52-week mean price target of $16.89, with targets ranging from $13.5 to $22. The stock has an average brokerage recommendation of 2.75, with ratings including one Buy, three Outperform, five Hold, and one Underperform. The company has a market capitalization of $3.55 billion.

To address the challenges of sparse and geographically concentrated genomic data, researchers developed a hierarchical Bayesian mixed-effects model to estimate viral variant dynamics. Unlike standard single-country regression methods that struggle with small sample sizes and geographic heterogeneity, this approach pools information globally to estimate within-country prevalence, growth rates, and global fitness. 

Applied to SARS-CoV-2, the model provided robust estimates of variant properties even in regions with limited sequencing capacity. Retrospective validation using BA.5 emergence in Portugal demonstrated that the multicountry model produced more stable estimates and more accurate probabilistic predictions (lower Brier scores) than single-country models. The framework is generalizable to various pathogens and geographic scales, offering improved situational awareness for public health decision-making in data-sparse regions.

The President appointed a special Advisory Commission on Civil Disorders, chaired by Governor Otto Kerner, to investigate recent urban disturbances and recommend preventative measures. While directing the FBI to investigate riots and the Secretary of Defense to issue new riot control training for the National Guard, the President emphasized that violence and crime are not part of civil rights protests. He argued that long-range solutions require addressing underlying conditions like poverty and discrimination through legislative action and social programs. Finally, he called for national prayer and reconciliation to restore order and mutual respect.

This paper examines Gorenstein-projective modules over the ring of dual integers $\mathbb{Z}[\epsilon]$. The authors establish that the category $G\text{-proj } \mathbb{Z}[\epsilon]$ is equivalent to torsionless $\mathbb{Z}[\epsilon]$-modules, perfect differential structures of abelian groups, and orbits of bounded complexes of free abelian groups. Furthermore, the stable category of $G\text{-proj } \mathbb{Z}[\epsilon]$ is shown to be equivalent to the stable category of submodules of finitely generated free $\mathbb{Z}[\epsilon]$-modules, the orbit category $D^b(\mathbb{Z})/[1]$, and the homotopy and stable categories of perfect differential structures. The study also describes a chain of categories linked by dense functors and a commutative cube of such functors.

Scotiabank's 1832 Asset Management LP will pay an $800,000 fine and $150,000 in costs to the Ontario Securities Commission for providing excessive non-monetary benefits to financial advisers between 2012 and 2017.

During a routine customer check-up call, Vodafone Ghana SME Enterprise team member Eunice Ampomah-Manu assisted Andrew Kufuor after he suffered a life-threatening attack. By staying on the line and contacting his wife, she ensured he received medical attention at a nearby clinic.

In the second rubber of Australia's Davis Cup quarter-final against the United States in Brisbane, Nick Kyrgios is scheduled to play John Isner in singles. The tie also features Jack Sock against Jordan Thompson, while Sam Groth and John Peers will face Sam Querrey and Steve Johnson in doubles.

Advances in information technologies, particularly high-performance computing (HPC), are transforming industrial development and manufacturing. Technologies such as simulation, modeling, digital twins, and IoT enable faster product development, optimized design, and new business models like "Product as a Service." While HPC increases innovation, agility, and calculation quality, enterprises face challenges including high costs, security concerns, energy consumption, and a lack of expertise. To address these, many organizations are moving toward cloud-based or hybrid HPC architectures and High-Performance Computing as a Service (HPCaaS) to gain scalability, flexibility, and cost-efficiency.

John Clarke, Michel Devoret, and John Martinis have won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physics for demonstrating quantum tunneling and energy quantization in an electric circuit. Their 1980s discovery involving Josephson junctions provided the foundation for superconducting qubits used in quantum computers.

On October 30, 2001, Enron Corp. shares fell to eight-year lows following a Moody's Investors Service downgrade of its long-term debt to two notches above junk status. The company is seeking new credit lines amid an SEC inquiry into off-balance-sheet transactions managed by former CFO Andrew Fastow. Despite these financial struggles, Enron Industrial Markets intends to continue its forest products trading venture.

This document provides design specifications and layout guidelines for TPS7H500x-SP controllers. Key design elements include the selection of an 80-V GaN FET for synchronous rectification, the use of an RCD clamp to limit switch node voltage, and the determination of output inductor and capacitance values to meet ripple and transient requirements. For space-grade designs, additional capacitance is recommended to mitigate radiation-induced single event transients. The text also details frequency compensation, slope compensation, and comprehensive PCB layout practices to minimize noise and ensure reliability.

The MSPM0G series microcontrollers feature a Power Management Unit (PMU) for core supply regulation and supervision, a Clock Module (CKM) providing various internal and external oscillators, and a Direct Memory Access (DMA) controller for CPU-independent data movement. The devices include an event manager for digital event transfers, non-volatile flash memory with ECC protection, and up to 128KB of SRAM. Peripherals include GPIO, IOMUX, dual 12-bit ADCs, a temperature sensor, VREF, a comparator (COMP), a 12-bit DAC, and various communication interfaces such as UART, I2C, SPI, and CAN-FD. Security is supported through AES accelerators, a Keystore, and a True Random Number Generator (TRNG). Additional features include a math accelerator (MATHACL), watchdog timers (IWDT and WWDT), and advanced/general-purpose timers (TIMx).

Proposed by Christine Peterson in February 1998, "open source" provided a commercially palatable alternative to "free software" by focusing on making source code available under licenses favoring user freedom. While once viewed as a threat to proprietary interests, open source now drives innovation and is utilized by major technology companies like Apple, Amazon, Google, and Microsoft.

J. Bernstorff informed that the blockade could end if a conference is held on reasonable terms. Energy storage technologies, such as lithium-ion batteries and pumped hydro, aim to manage renewable energy by storing power for later use. While lithium-ion batteries are effective for small-scale applications, they currently face high costs and economic challenges regarding variable electricity rates. Conversely, pumped hydro is a cheaper, large-scale solution for grid management. Other technologies include flywheels, compressed air, and flow batteries, each serving different grid needs.

An unsigned Irish Times "Portrait Gallery" article features a photograph of 1951 Nobel Prize winner Ernest Walton at Trinity College Dublin. Described as a quiet man fond of Ireland, Walton's historic achievement in smashing the atomic nucleus is noted as difficult for laymen to grasp.

On August 3, 2020, Apple Inc. filed an amendment to its Restated Articles of Incorporation to increase authorized common stock from 12,600,000,000 to 50,400,000,000 shares and to implement a four-for-one stock split effective August 28, 2020.

Bitcoin futures began trading on Cboe's Futures Exchange, offering a regulated alternative to the spot market. While the launch may increase market participation and long-term stability, some banks and brokerages have limited or declined access due to concerns regarding volatility, systemic risk, and inaccurate pricing.

The Korean diet focuses on whole, unprocessed foods, including vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, and fermented items like kimchi. While offering benefits such as high fiber and probiotics, the diet can be high in sodium, carbohydrates, and spice, and is low in dairy.
CoachingAmericanSoccer.com offers General “Rules of the Road” for on-field play to provide new players and coaches with guidance on team tactics, including positioning, ball work, and team functions.

This manual provides instructions for using the Sansa Fuze player, including transferring music, photos, and videos via drag-and-drop, Windows Media Player, or Sansa Media Converter. It details how to play various media types, use FM radio, record voice, and manage settings such as wallpaper, backlight, and power saver. Additionally, it covers troubleshooting, device formatting, and SanDisk's limited warranty and software license terms.

The team expressed support for Mr. Horton's recovery and noted the difficulty of Aaron being unable to participate in the playoffs. Despite a tough loss in Chicago, the team aims to focus on their next game and adjust their play.

The ADS9803 is an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS data acquisition system featuring a built-in analog front-end. It supports a speed-boost mode for a user-selected analog input channel pair, allowing sampling rates up to 8MSPS. The device features SPI configuration with support for register bank selection, register read/write operations, and daisy-chain topology for multiple devices. The ADS9803 includes two bandwidth modes—low-noise and wide-bandwidth—and utilizes three separate power supplies.

This retrospective study of 109 patients analyzed predictors for shunt-dependent hydrocephalus (SDHC) following aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage (aSAH). Multivariate logistic regression identified three significant risk factors for SDHC: age ≥65 years, surgical clipping versus coiling, and a Hunt and Hess scale (HHS) ≥3. Based on these variables, a predictive nomogram was developed to assist in clinical risk assessment.

Nike's fiscal first-quarter revenue rose 1% to $11.72 billion, exceeding Wall Street expectations despite a 31% drop in profits. While wholesale and North American sales grew, direct sales fell and revenue in China declined by 9%. CEO Elliott Hill is executing a turnaround strategy involving inventory management and corporate restructuring.

Dolphins receiver Tyreek Hill suffered a dislocated knee during the third quarter of a win over the Jets. After catching a pass from Tua Tagovailoa, Hill's left leg twisted under him, requiring him to be carted off and hospitalized for further testing.

An international team of scientists found live specimens of the giant shipworm, *Kuphus polythalamia*, in a Philippine lagoon. Researchers hope to discover new antimicrobial substances by studying the microbes in the animal's single gill.

A seasonal trading strategy for the German stock market involves investing in the iShares MSCI Germany ETF (EWG) only during the fourth quarter, as historical monthly returns since 1996 show this is the best time to be invested. Backtesting the strategy using EWG data shows it has performed well.

Climate change is warming and drying northern Rocky Mountain streams, allowing invasive rainbow trout to enter habitats previously protected by cold water. This leads to widespread hybridization with native cutthroat trout, producing less fit offspring and threatening the native species with permanent extinction.

Former INEC official Christian Nwosu testified before a Lagos Federal High Court that EFCC operatives coerced him into falsely admitting to receiving N30m from Dieziani Alison-Madueke. Nwosu alleged that operative Usman Zakari threatened him with detention to force the statement and that he was subsequently coerced into surrendering N5m in cash and property worth N30m.

A nationwide study published in the journal of the American Academy of Neurology linked long-term exposure to the industrial solvent trichloroethylene (TCE) in outdoor air to a 10% increased risk of Parkinson’s disease in older adults. Researchers analyzed over 1.1 million people, finding that those in areas with the highest TCE levels faced a higher risk than those in areas with the lowest levels. While the study shows an association rather than proving causation, it highlights the potential public health impact of this persistent environmental pollutant.

State Street Corporation has agreed to pay $5 million to settle claims that it discriminated against 305 female employees and 15 Black vice presidents through unequal pay. The firm denies the allegations but will provide $4.5 million in back pay and $500,000 in interest to a settlement fund. State Street had previously commissioned the "Fearless Girl" statue to celebrate women in leadership.
John Clarke, Michel Devoret, and John Martinis have won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physics for demonstrating quantum effects in an electric circuit.

A swimming advisory was issued for Port Stanley's Little Beach due to high bacteria levels, warning of potential gastrointestinal illness and infection. The Elgin St. Thomas Health Unit noted that while the advisory alerts visitors to health risks, the beach remains open to the public.

A 35-member jazz collective from Sir John Deane’s sixth form college performed 60s soul and classic swing at the Macdonald Portal Hotel during the fourth annual Evening of Jazz and Soul. The college's next event is a classical music performance by 14 students at Arley Hall on February 9.

In 2016, Evan and Brynn Meek distributed 220 lunches to homeless people in Manhattan. Additionally, Norwich Police Department veteran Thomas Miller accepted a position with the Syracuse Police Department, and Tracy A. Price of Norwich was arrested on charges of torturing and neglecting a dog.

Researchers at Chalmers University of Technology used machine learning and computer simulations to identify the low-temperature structure of formamidinium lead iodide, a halide perovskite material. This breakthrough helps explain the material's phase behavior, which is essential for engineering more stable, efficient, and flexible solar cells and optoelectronic devices.

Reinaldo De Jesus Henao, 36, was arrested at the Coachella festival after concertgoers used tracking features to locate him. Henao allegedly had over 100 stolen cellphones in his backpack and faces grand theft and possession of stolen property charges.

Wafa Yahia, the Syrian mother-in-law of Hawaii lawsuit plaintiff Ismail Elshikh, arrived in Honolulu on Saturday after receiving US government visa approval. While Elshikh credits the lawsuit for the family's reunion, Hawaii Attorney General Doug Chin stated that Yahia's arrival does not affect the ongoing legal challenge against the travel ban.

The event featured thousands of participants marching at Revolution Square, though without military equipment. A study in the Journal of Experimental Psychology suggests that general distraction, such as new hobbies or exercise, can boost mood short-term, though it should be used sparingly. Alternatively, focusing on the negative aspects of a past relationship can help a person move on faster.

To avoid sleeping on the back or right side during pregnancy, which can reduce circulation and blood flow to the placenta, the author purchased a U-shaped Leachco pregnancy pillow. Despite being large and having a scratchy cover, the pillow helped the author sleep on her side and stay comfortable while moving.

Vale SA's successful stock conversion plan, which saw 84.4 percent of preferred shares join, may accelerate the company's listing on Brazil's Novo Mercado to attract more investors. CEO Fabio Schvartsman and CFO Luciano Siani noted the move aims to merge stock classes and disperse ownership, though the government will retain a golden share.

This qualitative study used a phenomenology design to examine the perspectives of 10 primary school teachers regarding the virtual education of students with disabilities in inclusive settings during the COVID-19 pandemic. Findings indicated that while many students participated regularly with parental support, challenges included technical issues, low student motivation, lack of social interaction, and difficulties in tracking assignments. Teachers identified large class sizes, inadequate home environments, and varying levels of parental literacy or technological access as significant barriers. Proposed solutions included providing technological support, developing engaging content, and fostering stronger teacher-parent cooperation.

This paper argues for the adoption of cooperative (co-op) education in Nigeria to address youth unemployment and improve the transition from school to work. While Nigeria has implemented programs like SIWES, SURE-P, and N-SIP, these often lack the deep integration between academic curricula and industry needs found in co-op models. Co-op, a form of experiential learning that alternates study terms with work terms, offers benefits for students, employers, and educational institutions by aligning training with labor market demands. The author suggests that a federally driven co-op initiative, integrated into existing government frameworks, could help bridge the gap between theory and practice to meet the evolving skills requirements of the Nigerian labor market.

An analysis of 48,615 Omicron BA.1 genomes in England reveals that a small number of early introduction events, occurring before or during travel restrictions, accounted for approximately 80% of infections through January 2022. Greater London served as a central hub for initial spatial expansion, with subsequent spread influenced by human mobility and population density. Additionally, the study found that increases in COVID-19 case prevalence at major travel hubs were associated with a reduction in human mobility.

The TLV321/2x family of comparators consumes 40uA per channel with 40ns of propagation delay. The TLV321x features a push-pull output, while the TLV322x features an open-drain output capable of being pulled up to 5.5V. The device includes 1.8mV of internal hysteresis and an internal Power-on-Reset circuit. Inputs are limited to 200mV beyond the supply rails, and TI recommends limiting input current to 10mA or less.

The NVIDIA Ampere GA10x architecture introduces several advancements over the Turing generation, including second-generation RT Cores that double ray/triangle intersection rates and support hardware-accelerated motion blur. Third-generation Tensor Cores feature a new sparsity capability that can double effective throughput and support new data types like TF32 and BF16. The architecture also features a 33% larger combined L1 data cache and shared memory capacity per SM, and doubles peak FP32 processing rates by adding floating-point capability to both datapaths. The memory subsystem utilizes GDDR6X with PAM4 signaling to achieve higher bandwidth. Additionally, NVIDIA RTX IO provides GPU-based lossless decompression to accelerate I/O performance when used with Microsoft DirectStorage.
