An EF-0 tornado with 75 mph winds touched down near the Prince William County line on Friday, August 11. The storm lasted two minutes, causing damage along a mile-long path in Fauquier County. No injuries were reported.

Apple Inc.'s Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended June 29, 2019, reports total net sales of $53,809 million, a 1% increase from $53,265 million in the same quarter of 2018. This growth was driven by higher Wearables, Home and Accessories and Services net sales, which partially offset lower iPhone net sales. Net income for the three months ended June 29, 2019, was $10,044 million, compared to $11,519 million in the prior year's third quarter. As of June 29, 2019, total assets were $322,239 million and total liabilities were $225,783 million.

The speaker advises the team to focus on pushing for a win and shooting the puck rather than worrying about mistakes. They suggest continuing to attack, using fakes to find openings, and hoping for a favorable bounce.

This research investigated the difficulties of transitioning from face-to-face to distance education in university-level foreign language instruction during the Covid-19 pandemic. Surveying 294 German and English students, the study found that students consider distance education unsuccessful for foreign language teaching. The highest reported problem was related to internet and computer issues, specifically connection interruptions. Other significant challenges included student motivation, insufficient mutual communication, and problematic measurement and evaluation processes. Results indicated that students without independent study rooms, home internet, or training in distance education software experienced higher levels of difficulty. The authors recommend providing awareness training for both students and teachers and implementing a hybrid education model.

Federal Reserve Chair Janet Yellen expects moderate economic expansion, a strengthening job market, and inflation rising to 2 percent. The FOMC will evaluate if employment and inflation align with these expectations to determine if adjusting the federal funds rate is appropriate. While uncertainty exists regarding fiscal policy and productivity, Yellen noted that waiting too long to tighten policy could risk recession. The unemployment rate has improved, and business investment and sentiment have recently increased.

Dereck James Harrison pleaded guilty to first-degree murder and kidnapping in the May slaying of Utah train worker Kay Porter Ricks to avoid the death penalty. Prosecutors agreed to drop two charges as part of the plea deal. Harrison, who is already serving time in Utah, claimed his father, Flint Harrison, killed Ricks. The Harrisons were arrested following a manhunt after kidnapping a woman and her daughters.

Jaguar Animal Cmn (NASDAQ:JAGX) shares fell 1.75% to a closing price of $0.21. One analyst projects a 52-week price target of $1.25. The stock has an ATR-14 of 0.04, an RSI of 55.65, and a market capitalization of $22.14 million.

The lecture covers the quantization of Dirac theory, noting that standard commutation relations lead to an unbounded Hamiltonian and bosonic behavior. To resolve this, anticommutation relations are imposed, which ensures a positive definite Hamiltonian and satisfies the Pauli principle, characterizing the particles as fermions. 

The theory defines particles and antiparticles with identical mass and spin (1/2) but opposite charges. The charge is derived from the Noether current associated with U(1) symmetry. The lecture also details correlation functions, demonstrating that the fermionic Feynman propagator in momentum space is the inverse of the matrix $(i\cancel{k} - m)$. Finally, the instructor introduces the concepts of chiral and Majorana fermions as methods to reduce the components of the Dirac spinor.

The ADS868xW is a 16-bit SAR ADC with an integrated analog front-end and precision reference. Data transfer frames are initiated by pulling the CONVST/CS pin low and end when it is pulled high. The device supports various multiSPI protocols, including legacy SPI-compatible modes (single or dual SDO-x) and source-synchronous (SRC) modes. Configuration is managed through nine registers, and the device features programmable low-power modes (NAP and power-down) and user-programmable input and AVDD alarms with hysteresis.

This study analyzed the interaction between a mitochondrial polygenic score (MGS) and lifestyle/environmental factors on the age at onset (AAO) of LRRK2-Parkinson’s disease (LRRK2-PD) and idiopathic Parkinson’s disease (iPD) using three datasets. Results showed that a higher MGS was inversely correlated with AAO in LRRK2-PD patients, particularly those of European descent. In LRRK2-PD, interactions were detected between MGS and coffee or caffeinated soda consumption, where high MGS was associated with earlier AAO in consumers. In iPD, interactions were found between MGS and caffeinated soda consumption, as well as between MGS and occupational pesticide exposure.

On November 21, 2001, Enron Corp. announced it had secured the remaining $450 million of a $1 billion credit line and received an extension from lenders to pay a $690 million note until mid-December. Despite these developments and a reaffirmed commitment to its merger with Dynegy Inc., Enron's shares fell significantly due to liquidity concerns and doubts regarding the takeover. Concurrently, Goldman Sachs downgraded both Enron and Dynegy to "market perform."

The disclosure provides a system and method for periodic beam failure measurements in digital communications. To prevent missed beam failures caused by measurement periods lacking assessed reference signals, a user equipment (UE) determines measurement period durations based on the periods of beam failure detection reference signals (BFD RSs) that have a quasi-co-located (QCL) relationship with demodulation reference signals (DMRSs) of monitored control channel receptions. The UE monitors a subset of these BFD RSs and reports a beam failure (BF) instance if the measures of all BFD RSs in the subset do not meet a specified threshold. Additionally, the disclosure addresses how to handle measurement periods where no BFD RS is transmitted, such as when a signal overlaps with control signaling, by either ignoring the period or treating it as a beam failure instance to avoid resetting the consecutive BF instance counter.

U.S. stocks ended lower on Tuesday as geopolitical tensions involving Russia, Syria, and North Korea weighed on sentiment ahead of corporate earnings season. The Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq all closed down, while the VIX rose above 15.

The multi-objective three-layer optimization (MOTO) framework is introduced for systematic local-landscape mapping of potential energy surfaces. The framework consists of a multi-objective explorer for diverse initial guesses, a bilayer minimum-mode kernel using Hessian-vector products (HVP) to locate index-1 saddles, and a deterministic two-sided minimum-mode descent to certify connectivity. Benchmarking on atomistic spin systems demonstrates that the HVP-based approach scales efficiently with reduced memory and runtime compared to explicit-Hessian methods. MOTO successfully mapped transition-state networks in a DFT-parameterized Pd/Fe/Ir(111) spin model and a Ni(111) heptamer, demonstrating its portability from spin manifolds to Cartesian atomic systems.

NVIDIA Corporation's Q1 FY18 report for the period ended April 30, 2017, shows revenue of $1,937 million, up 48% year-over-year, and net income of $507 million, up 144% from the previous year. Growth was driven by the GPU and Tegra Processor segments. The company reported a gross margin of 59.4%. As of April 30, 2017, NVIDIA held $6.21 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities.

After Google fired James Damore for a memo arguing that biological differences cause gender disparities in tech, neuroscience research suggests that sex differences are not innate or fixed. Evidence indicates that brains are plastic, changing based on experience, attitudes, and expectations. Studies show that skills like spatial cognition can be improved through training and that "stereotype threat" can negatively impact brain activity and performance. Consequently, empowerment techniques and environmental changes can alter brain processes and overcome perceived biological limitations.

The DOLE-6 is preparing to assist approximately 17,000 Boracay workers potentially displaced by the island's closure. Plans include organizing job fairs with the DOT-6 and local governments, partnering with TESDA for skill upgrading, and deploying a quick response team for worker profiling.

Lamar Jackson suffered a hamstring injury during a Week 4 game against Kansas City. While injury severity remains undetermined, reports vary: the Baltimore Sun suggested he could miss 2-3 weeks, while Ian Rapoport described it as "week to week." Jackson did not practice during Week 5 and was labeled "doubtful" for the Houston game. One source indicated he may not return until after the Ravens' Week 7 bye.

Medicare-funded "hospital at home" programs are pausing or shutting down as a deadline approaches for the reauthorization of Covid-era waivers. Hospitals including UMass Memorial, Hackensack Meridian Health, and Mass General Brigham have already reduced admissions or discharged patients due to the potential expiration of the program on Sept. 30. Experts note that these programs help ease hospital overcrowding, but the uncertainty regarding congressional action and government funding limits hospital investment in the model.

This study investigated perceptions of ICT and CALL integration in a Vietnamese tertiary EFL initial teacher education program using a convergent mixed-methods design. Findings indicated that pre-service teachers perceived a high presence of opportunities to learn CALL-related knowledge, particularly regarding resource discovery and digital media. However, several factors were identified as impacting integration: individual educator obstacles (such as limited confidence and fear of change), pre-service teacher-related issues (such as disengagement), inadequate infrastructure (unstable internet and unreliable equipment), and a lack of official institutional policies or guidelines regarding technology implementation.

The court held that the intact value of the trust estate should be fixed as of the testator's date of death, rather than when the trustee received the stocks. Consequently, life tenants are entitled to undistributed earnings accruing from the date of death. Regarding stock owned by the Booth & Flinn Company, the court determined the intact value should be the book value at the time the executors received it as a dividend. Finally, the court accepted the method of averaging yearly earnings on a per diem basis to determine undistributed earnings.

The authors argue that global citizenship education lacks sufficient theoretical frameworks to explain increasing international conflicts and the conditions for peaceful cooperation. While the field emphasizes issues like human rights and environmentalism, it often overlooks national security, economic cooperation, and the role of state power. To address these gaps, the paper suggests supplementing global citizenship education with political science theories—specifically realism, regionalism, and institutionalism—to help young people understand why conflicts arise and how states interact. Furthermore, the authors propose expanding the educational agenda to include engagement with national foreign policy, as states remain the primary actors in addressing global challenges and managing international relations.

The speaker believes the team needs to calm down after being over-motivated and taking multiple penalties. While the penalty killing has been successful due to coaching and defensive work, the team must remain patient and avoid overcommitting against an opponent with talented, fast-moving players. Success against this group requires smart play and staying out of the penalty box.

Following the signing of the armistice on November 11, 1918, President Woodrow Wilson announced that America's goals were accomplished and expressed a duty to assist in establishing global democracy. Various international leaders and representatives, including Edward House, Robert Lansing, S. Pichon, Uchida, and the Greek Legation, sent telegrams expressing congratulations, admiration for American contributions, and hopes for future peace and the establishment of a Society of Nations.

This mixed-methods study explored integrating music notation software, specifically Sibelius, into a general music education course for pre-service teachers at a Caribbean university. While the program traditionally relied on lectures and manual methods, this research introduced software to deliver specific music content. Results indicated that the software could be successfully integrated, with participants completing a composition assignment with 90% accuracy. Findings suggested that the technology enhanced conceptual understanding and performance, though many students expressed a need for further training and some preferred traditional approaches. The study recommends the continued, gradual use of music software, increased training for lecturers and students, and the inclusion of technological competence in practicum assessments and final evaluations.
The court affirmed the order dismissing a writ of habeas corpus and remanding the relator, based on Justice Hagarty's opinion.

Following feedback, reports will be sent by a 1pm deadline. Globo's share price is 145p with a market cap of £188.2m. CEO Oozi Cats has resigned from the Board after an independent review confirmed he had a US indictment for fraud that was withheld from advisers.

Using the James Webb Space Telescope and Hubble Space Telescope, astronomers led by Northwestern University identified the progenitor of supernova SN2025pht in galaxy NGC 1637. The star was a massive red supergiant obscured by a dense, carbon-rich dust cloud. This first confirmed detection of a supernova progenitor via JWST suggests that thick dust may explain why such stars are often difficult to observe before they explode.

This study introduces the "Simplified Egg and Changing Yolk Model" to explain ventricular repolarisation and various T-wave morphologies on ECG traces. The model views the heart as an egg-shaped mass where a repolarisation signal expands from Wilson’s Central Terminal (WCT) through an asymmetrical "T-zone." This framework can simulate ECG abnormalities such as ST elevation, ST depression, and atypical T-wave patterns by modeling electrically inert or damaged muscle areas. Additionally, the study suggests that the QTp interval (Q-wave start to T-wave peak) is a more reliable and accurate parameter for assessing arrhythmia risk and medication effects than the commonly used corrected QT interval (QTc).

The disclosure describes methods and systems for creating virtual game environments from real-world scenes. The process involves selecting physical objects, arranging them into a physical model, and using a capturing device (such as a 3D or depth-sensitive camera) to obtain a digital three-dimensional representation. This representation is converted into a virtual toy construction model composed of virtual elements, which are then used to define game-controlling elements based on the physical properties of the objects, such as color, shape, and dimensions.

The disclosure also details a computationally efficient method for voxelization, converting a digital mesh representation of a surface into a voxel-based representation. This involves mapping surface elements to a grid of discretized volume elements (voxels) and assigning them attributes, such as color, from a predetermined palette. Additionally, the disclosure covers an interactive game system that can recognize known physical objects to create responsive virtual environments and a cyclic gameplay loop where users create environments, play game segments, and initiate new cycles based on outcomes.

This study explores the experiences of undergraduate education-related programme leaders in English further education (FE) colleges using a "lifelong learning ecology" framework. Research findings indicate that these leaders act as a "keystone species," managing multifaceted responsibilities including administrative demands, academic support, and student pastoral care. The study identifies tensions caused by competing demands across macro, exo, and micro layers, such as navigating institutional partnerships and managing diverse student needs. While these leaders possess significant "craft wisdom," they face challenges regarding ill-defined roles, limited opportunities for scholarly activity, and institutional pressures that can obscure their ability to engage with broader academic communities.

Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid al-Maktoum announced the Mars 2117 Project, which aims to build the first inhabitable human settlement on Mars by 2117. Partnering with international scientific institutions, the project will focus on developing faster travel to the planet, starting with an Emirati scientific team.

Gbenga Ogundele and his wife, Mojisola Oluwakemi Tin Popoola, were sentenced to 234 months and 18 months in federal prison, respectively, for conspiracies to commit wire fraud and money laundering. The couple participated in an internet dating scam that defrauded victims of millions of dollars between 2011 and 2015. Ogundele was also convicted of aggravated identity theft and ordered to forfeit over $2.1 million. Other co-conspirators, including Babatunde Emmanuel Popoola and Victor Oyewumi Oloyede, received prison sentences for their roles in the scheme.

The present application provides a compound represented by Chemical Formula 1 and an organic light emitting device including the same. The compound is used in organic electronic devices to lower driving voltage, improve light efficiency, and enhance lifetime characteristics through thermal stability. The device includes a first electrode, a second electrode, and one or more organic material layers, where at least one layer contains the compound.

Maria Saliagas, a woman with multiple sclerosis, alleges Delta Air Lines employees tied her to a regular wheelchair with a blanket because a chair with straps was unavailable. Her son reported she suffered bruising from the incident. Delta expressed regret over the perception of their service and offered 20,000 SkyMiles, but the family is seeking policy changes regarding disability handling.

Striker Martyn Waghorn, who returns to the Stadium of Light with Ipswich Town this Saturday, credits former Sunderland youth coach Kevin Ball for teaching him the fundamentals of football after he nearly faced release at age 15.

Increased truck traffic on Arkansas 43 near Ponca has led to frequent accidents, as GPS technology often fails to warn drivers of steep grades and sharp curves. In response to seven recent wrecks on a two-mile stretch, the Highway Department plans to install warning signs regarding the terrain.

This protocol describes a descriptive, register-based cohort study using the Danish Hip Arthroplasty Register to examine trends in revision types for periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) following primary total hip arthroplasty from 1995 to 2022. The study aims to categorize revisions into debridement, antibiotics, and implant retention (DAIR), one-stage exchange, and two-stage exchange, while also assessing the risk of a second revision for each approach.

The invention relates to floor cleaners featuring a vacuum source, a supply tank for cleaning fluid, a distribution nozzle, a suction inlet, and a recovery tank. Embodiments include recovery tanks with movable strainers, shutoff floats to prevent fluid from entering the suction air outlet, and covers with filter apertures. The floor cleaner includes a base and a pivotable body, with component placement designed to maintain a balanced center of gravity. Additional features include a hydrophobic brushroll, a steerable design using a yoke link, a removable brushroll cover with dual actuators, and integrated lights to illuminate the spray pattern. The base also incorporates squeegees to manage fluid and debris.

During a basketball game in Bocaue, Bulacan, the Philippine national team faced a significant loss to Australia, which ended in a default after a physical altercation involving players and spectators. While Australia led 89-53, the match escalated into a confrontation characterized by thrown objects and fighting. The Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas apologized for the breach of hospitality, stating that violence has no place in sports, while the incident is viewed as a setback for the team's global reputation.

The "Give & Go" isolation offense utilizes two primary ball handlers in a 2-1-2 spread alignment. Players execute basket cuts or back cuts when passing lanes are denied, or use dribble penetration when defenders play soft. The post and weakside players provide pressure releases or exchanges to maintain continuity and occupy defenders.

Leam Richardson dismissed reports of a significant tunnel altercation between Ivan Toney and Nathan Pond following Wigan Athletic's match against Fleetwood, describing it as a brief incident. Richardson noted the players were laughing afterward. Wigan now prepares to face AFC Fylde for a potential FA Cup third-round tie against Bournemouth.

This study uses Q methodology to examine teachers' perceptions of culturally responsive education within the Turkish education system. Analyzing responses from 21 teachers in various cities, the research identified three primary factors: "Unification," "Student Support," and "Teacher Support." Findings indicate that while teachers generally view the Turkish education system as inclusive and seeing diversity as a richness, they also perceive existing inequalities regarding different cultures. The study concludes that while initial steps toward multiculturalism have been taken, the system requires further development in curriculum, teacher training, and student support to become fully culturally responsive.

An electronic device may feature an enclosure with transparent and opaque walls, where display layers are mounted under transparent portions and touch sensor layers are mounted under both transparent and opaque portions. The device may include a front wall, a rear wall, and sidewalls that can be flat or curved. In foldable configurations, flexible transparent wall portions may join planar transparent walls, and display or touch layers may be overlapped by these walls. Touch sensor structures may be formed as coatings on the inner surfaces of enclosure walls or attached using adhesive layers.

Progressive reported February 2018 results including a 19% increase in net earned premiums to $2,204.7 million and an 87.8% combined ratio. While net income decreased 4% compared to February 2017, the company raised $1,083.4 million through public offerings for corporate purposes. The author estimates the company's intrinsic value is between $48 and $54 per share and expects the 2018 dividend per share to be between $0.76 and $1.85, though they consider the stock overvalued.

The dual momentum strategy, developed by Gary Antonacci, is a trend-based investing method that combines absolute momentum (an asset's own rate of change) and relative momentum (an asset's performance compared to peers). The strategy seeks to buy assets that demonstrate both positive absolute momentum and the highest relative momentum among peers during bullish markets. Conversely, in markets where shorting is accessible, such as futures, the strategy can identify the "weakest of the weak" by shorting assets with both negative absolute and negative relative momentum. Research suggests this approach can reduce volatility and drawdowns compared to traditional buy-and-hold strategies, though it may underperform during strong bull markets or rapid rebounds.

The Break, a longtime restaurant and billiards hall in Birmingham's Five Points South, will be demolished for high-rise apartments. While some residents hope the new luxury apartments will revitalize the area, others expressed a desire for more affordable housing due to rising rents.

Neiman Gracie will fight Dave Marfone at Bellator 180 on June 24 in New York City after his offer to fight Dillon Danis was denied. Gracie stated he does not care about Danis, whom he considers an amateur because Danis has no professional MMA experience.

US researchers found that a half-degree rise in average annual temperature correlates to a 1% drop in secondary student exam scores. In the UK, the lack of air conditioning may exacerbate this, particularly in June when temperatures often exceed 21C during exam periods. While changing the academic calendar could mitigate heat-related performance issues, such shifts are complicated by existing institutional schedules and the need for standardized testing to maintain grading rigor.

The advance-decline (AD) indicator, or AD line, is a market breadth indicator that plots the cumulative daily difference between advancing and declining stocks. It is used to confirm trends or predict reversals through divergence. Advancing issues are stocks trading above the previous close, while declining issues trade below it. The indicator reflects market sentiment, where rising values suggest gaining momentum and falling values suggest losing momentum. A backtest of the NYSE advance-decline indicator using the SPY ETF showed inconsistent results and a profit factor of 1.55.

Dive tour operators are divided on whether the ex-HMAS Tobruk landing on its side will affect tourism. Glenn Bowman of Dive Hervey Bay fears reduced income due to limited accessibility for general divers, while Ed Gibson of Hervey Bay Dive Centre believes tourism will thrive through tour adjustments. The Queensland Parks and Wildlife Service is awaiting a safety inspection report to determine how to best create dive opportunities.

After 15 days of negotiations in Washington, California and electricity suppliers failed to reach a settlement regarding the state's demand for $8.9 billion in refunds. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission administrative law judge Curtis L. Wagner indicated that any refunds would likely be significantly less than the state's claim, potentially totaling around $1 billion, and would only cover power sold since October 2000. Governor Gray Davis stated that California would seek the full $8.9 billion through court action if necessary.

Rapid advancements in generative AI present legal and ethical challenges, such as misinformation, deepfakes, and societal bias, while complicating existing regulatory frameworks. Current governance faces macro-level gaps in communication between industry and government, as well as international regulatory inconsistencies. Additionally, the complex nature of LLMs creates micro-level risks that may only be identified during real-world use. To address these issues, the authors propose a human-centered approach combining top-down partnerships among industry, academia, and policymakers with bottom-up mechanisms for users and developers to report emerging risks.

Wealthy women have launched various business ventures, often facing significant financial challenges. Millie Mackintosh's fashion range closed following substantial losses and debts. Ella Mills' delicatessen business faced losses and closures, though her snack and cookbook firm remains profitable. Trinny Woodall's make-up brand has seen both profit and loss but is supported by wealthy investors. Petra and Tamara Ecclestone's fashion and haircare businesses have reported heavy losses. Alexa Chung's fashion company has faced losses but received millions in investment from wealthy friends. Kate Rothschild's record label collapsed, and Sadie Frost's lingerie label, Frost French, eventually dissolved after mounting debts.

The speaker suggests being more aggressive offensively and going to the net. Detroit's defense has adjusted well to take away shooting lanes, and both goaltenders are playing great during this tight defensive battle. The speaker also notes that the fans are the most enthusiastic in the league.

Global Ferronickel Holdings, Inc. subsidiary Platinum Group Metals Corp. renewed a contract to supply 1.5 million wet metric tons of medium grade nickel ore to Guangdong Century Tsingshan Nickel Industry Co., Ltd. at prevailing 2018 market prices.

The Supreme Court will maintain normal operations during a potential government shutdown using permanent funds, though lower courts may face curtailed operations. Meanwhile, Chief Justice John Roberts marks 20 years on the bench as the Court prepares for major issues regarding elections and free speech. Additionally, state attorneys general are challenging a 2008 death penalty ruling, former Michigan athletes are appealing a dismissed NIL lawsuit, and lawyers are petitioning the Court to protect the status of Venezuelan citizens.

The Office of the Historian at the U.S. Department of State produces the Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) series, which serves as the official record of U.S. foreign policy. Guided by principles of historical objectivity, the series includes documents regarding major foreign policy decisions and their contributing facts. The 1942 Volume II, Europe, was prepared by the Foreign Relations staff under the supervision of G. Bernard Noble and E. R. Perkins.

Salem residents are seeking bottled water following an announcement that the city's drinking water is contaminated by cyanotoxins from an algae bloom. Sensitive groups, including children under six and pregnant women, should not drink the water. While retailers expect shipments, local stores are reporting shortages.
Eurozone stock markets slumped on Friday as the euro pressured the US dollar and traders awaited US jobs data. The DAX, CAC 40, and STOXX 600 all fell, while London's FTSE 100 saw smaller losses.

This paper introduces Bolt, a new tool for learning Linear Temporal Logic on finite traces (LTLf) by combining the VFB algorithm with a Boolean Set Cover solver. To address the exponential complexity of LTLf learning, the authors propose treating Boolean and temporal operators differently, using a greedy beam search algorithm to solve the Boolean Set Cover problem. Experimental results using a new benchmark suite of over 15,000 tasks demonstrate that Bolt outperforms the state-of-the-art tool, Scarlet, by solving more tasks with faster wall-clock times and smaller formula sizes.
On February 9, 2017, NVIDIA Corporation issued a press release and CFO commentary regarding its financial results for the quarter and fiscal year ended January 29, 2017.

The offense aims to advance the ball to the end zone or kick a field goal using specialized positions. The quarterback leads the offense, making decisions on passing and running plays and potentially calling "audibles." Running backs carry the ball, catch passes, and block. Tight ends are versatile players who act as a mix of receivers and linemen, categorized as "attached" or "sniffers." The offensive line consists of five players: tackles protect the edges, guards play between the center and tackles, and the center directs the line and snaps the ball. Wide receivers catch passes and are categorized as split ends, flankers, or slot receivers.

To end a job interview effectively, rise, shake hands, and depart without lingering or asking about decision timelines. Successful candidates demonstrate confidence by focusing on the opportunity rather than appearing desperate for the position.

Research published in *Psychological Science* suggests humans interpret emotions by analyzing eye expressions, which evolved from universal sensory reactions to environmental stimuli. A study by Adam Anderson and Daniel H. Lee found that eye openness is the primary feature for reading mental states: narrowed eyes relate to visual discrimination and emotions like disgust, while open eyes relate to visual sensitivity and emotions like fear. Participants could accurately discern six basic emotions from the eyes alone, which provided more robust emotional indications than other facial features.

Due to a shortage of funds and teacher involvement in SSLC evaluations and elections, the department of primary and secondary education may not hold summer camps at state government schools this year.

A study commissioned by Vegreville, Alberta, suggests that relocating the federal Immigration, Refugee and Citizenship Case Processing Centre to Edmonton would cause population loss, lower property values, and higher unemployment. The centre, which employs 236 people, is scheduled to move by the end of 2018.

Brendon Naidoo was granted R50,000 bail at the Alexandra Magistrate Court following allegations of fraud involving a foreign-exchange trading scheme. As a condition of his bail, Naidoo must report to the Sandton Police station twice weekly.

A study conducted between 2020 and 2021 in the Western Uttar Pradesh region of India isolated 150 Enterobacteriaceae from untreated wastewater. The isolates, primarily E. coli (62%) and K. pneumoniae (24%), showed a 74% multidrug-resistance (MDR) prevalence, with 79.3% identified as ESBL producers. Resistance was observed across various antibiotic classes, including carbapenems and the last-resort antibiotic colistin. The findings suggest that indiscriminate antibiotic use during the COVID-19 pandemic and inadequate wastewater treatment contribute to the spread of AMR in both metropolitan and non-metropolitan areas.
The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John Clarke, Michel Devoret, and John Martinis for discovering macroscopic quantum mechanical tunnelling and energy quantisation in an electric circuit.
Job interviews range from banal to complex multi-stage processes or "zany" methods used by "disruptors" who ask unconventional questions.

The device features various system-level resets, including Power-on Reset (POR), External Warm Reset, Emulation Warm Reset, Watchdog Reset, Software Global Cold/Warm Resets, and Test Reset. PLL and analog supplies require filtering, ideally using a Pi filter with ferrite beads and capacitors placed close to device pins. For power supply decoupling, 0.1uF capacitors in small physical sizes (no larger than 0402) are recommended, with one capacitor for every two power pins and bulk capacitors (10 uF or larger) for every 10 pins. The device includes several peripherals, such as an Ethernet MAC Switch with reset isolation, a High-Definition Multimedia Interface (HDMI) 1.3a-compliant transmitter, a High-Definition Video Processing Subsystem (HDVPSS), and a General-Purpose Memory Controller (GPMC).

The Indiana Court of Appeals affirmed the Class A felony conspiracy to deal in cocaine convictions for Anthony Davis and Eric Simmons. The court ruled that the aggregate weight of cocaine from separate transactions could support the felony enhancement and that the jury's verdicts were not irreconcilably inconsistent. Additionally, the court upheld Davis's enhanced sentence, finding that his criminal history alone justified the penalty.

Construction of Fort Buford began in 1866 at the confluence of the Missouri and Yellowstone Rivers. The military post faced challenges including poor food quality, scurvy, supply disruptions from frozen rivers, and soldier boredom. While a 1876 report noted mental health issues, it also highlighted the post's library. A museum opened in the old headquarters in 1963.

Miso Robotics' "Flippy," a burger-flipping robot, has begun working as a grill cook at a Caliburger in Pasadena. Designed to work alongside humans, the AI-driven robot uses sensors and various tools to cook burgers and potentially other items. Caliburger has exclusive use of the $60,000 unit for six months before it becomes available to other vendors.

The device features several subsystems with specific reset and clocking capabilities. It supports reset isolation for the PCI Express (PCIE) module and the Ethernet Switch (EMAC Switch), the latter of which can be isolated via the RESET_ISO register to prevent disruption during system resets. The device includes various clocking structures, including internal oscillators, external crystal support, and 12 top-level PLLs. Peripherals such as the HDMI transmitter, High-Definition Video Processing Subsystem (HDVPSS), Imaging Subsystem (ISS), and DDR2/DDR3 memory controller provide specialized video, imaging, and memory interface functionalities. Additionally, the device incorporates GPIO, I2C, DCAN, and EDMA controllers to manage various communication and data transfer tasks.

Engineer John Essey uses Internet of Things technology to automate his home, a practice that can be achieved through expensive smart appliances or unwieldy sensors. To simplify this, Carnegie Mellon student Gierad Laput developed a single, small sensor capable of monitoring various environmental activities. However, experts like Bruce Schneier warn that these devices pose security risks and may facilitate corporate surveillance for profit.

Deutsche Telekom, Nokia, and the Hamburg Port Authority are testing 5G functionality across an 8,000-hectare industrial area. The trial will test network slicing under live conditions for use cases including traffic light management, real-time data processing, and virtual reality applications.

The team's playoff success relies on focusing on one game at a time rather than the big picture. Key factors include a player's leadership and consistency, managing poor ice and glass conditions, and defensive focus. Winning the Stanley Cup allows players to support causes like children's hospitals. While the team has more offensive skill this year, they must prepare for a challenging opponent and the difficulty of facing a team experienced in bouncing back from losses.

For the fiscal quarter ended June 26, 2021, Apple Inc. reported total net sales of $81,434 million, a 36% increase from $59,685 million in the same quarter of 2020. Net income for the quarter was $21,744 million, compared to $11,253 million in the prior year period. Growth was driven by increases in all product and service categories, including iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables, Home and Accessories, and Services. For the nine months ended June 26, 2021, total net sales reached $282,457 million.

Prosecutors dismissed the most serious charges against 18-year-old Jack Sawyer, who was accused of plotting a school shooting, following a state Supreme Court ruling. Sawyer will face lesser charges of criminal threatening and carrying a dangerous weapon. The case prompted Vermont Governor Phil Scott to sign new gun restriction laws.
Since 2000, only 12 albums have spent 10 or more weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200. Taylor Swift and Morgan Wallen each have three albums on the list, while Adele has two.

On October 22, 2001, Enron Corp. shares fell over 20 percent after the company announced the SEC had requested information regarding related-party transactions involving limited partnerships managed by CFO Andrew Fastow. Shareholders filed derivative and class action lawsuits alleging the board breached fiduciary duties and that these partnerships caused substantial losses and conflicts of interest. Enron reported a $618 million third-quarter loss and a $1.01 billion charge related to failed investments and the partnerships. While Enron stated the arrangements were approved by the board and disclosed in filings, analysts expressed concerns regarding potential dilution and the costs of dismantling affiliated companies.

Dobrynin and the Secretary discussed expanding bilateral cooperation, including creating an inventory of bilateral agreements. Dobrynin proposed exploring various national security topics and broader issues like the Middle East and the Prague Declaration. The Secretary emphasized the importance of human rights and regional issues such as Poland and Afghanistan. While the Secretary preferred conducting arms control negotiations in Geneva, he did not rule out discussing INF and START in the Shultz-Gromyko channel.

Clio, a legal technology company, acquired global legal research platform vLex for $1 billion. This acquisition, following previous purchases of ShareDo and Lawyaw, provides users with near start-to-finish capabilities for legal practice and law firm management.

During a Week 4 game against the Jets, Dolphins wide receiver Tyreek Hill suffered a dislocated knee. Head coach Mike McDaniel confirmed the injury and stated that Hill is not expected to return in 2025.

This qualitative study examines the relationship between science and citizenship education in Turkey through curriculum analysis and interviews with eight science educators. Findings indicate that both the curriculum and teachers connect science to citizenship via scientific literacy, society, the environment, and specific values and skills. While the curriculum includes objectives related to environmental sustainability and socio-scientific issues, educators reported that practical implementation is hindered by an exam-oriented education system, infrastructural deficiencies, and overcrowded classrooms. The study concludes that science education has significant potential to foster responsible, active citizens, but requires better policy integration and teacher support to achieve these goals.

UFC 216 in Las Vegas features Demetrious Johnson attempting an 11th title defense against Ray Borg and an interim lightweight title fight between Tony Ferguson and Kevin Lee. The UFC has pledged $1 million to assist victims of a recent mass shooting in the city.

A study of 121 future preschool and primary school teachers at the University of Belgrade investigated their conceptions of robots using the Draw-A-Robot Test (DART). Most participants demonstrated accurate understandings, with the most common depictions being animal-shaped robots (47.1%) and typical or mechanical objects. The primary perceived functions were educational and assistive. While misconceptions existed—most notably depicting robots as common electronic appliances—the study found that future preschool teachers had more in-person experience and prioritized the cognitive domain in their robot depictions compared to primary school teachers. The findings suggest that while most future educators possess well-founded understandings, curricula should be updated to enhance digital competencies and the purposeful integration of robotics in classrooms.

Veteran tackle Byron Bell has agreed to a deal with the Green Bay Packers, adding competition to an offensive line seeking a starting right tackle. Bell joins a group including Bryan Bulaga, who is recovering from a torn ACL, and players Jason Spriggs and Kyle Murphy, both of whom are returning from injuries.

Successful out of bounds play requires practicing simple, effective inbounds passes and plays that prioritize getting the ball to best players. Players must understand rules, such as the five-second limit and vertical plane restrictions, and be able to execute reads based on defensive deployment. Coaches should scout opponents and test players' rule knowledge to ensure preparedness.

The Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR) is driving a shift toward Education 4.0, which emphasizes individualized, skill-based learning and the integration of technologies like artificial intelligence. Digital Game-Based Learning (DGBL) is an emerging pedagogical approach that uses digital games to foster cognitive and non-cognitive skills through immersive, engaging experiences. A key application is "stealth assessment" (SA), an automated process that uses machine learning and evidence-centered design to assess student competencies in real-time during gameplay without increasing test anxiety. While DGBL offers benefits for motivation and personalized feedback, challenges remain regarding its development, potential cognitive load, and the need for further research to establish its validity and reliability.

Neutrinos are produced by various sources, including supernova explosions, the Big Bang, cosmic ray showers, the sun, particle accelerators, and nuclear reactors. Experimental studies of neutrino oscillations utilize parameters such as length, energy, and mass range sensitivity. Solar neutrino experiments, such as Davis and SNO, provided evidence of flavor evolution through observed neutrino disappearance and total flux measurements. Atmospheric neutrino studies observed muon neutrino disappearance based on zenith angles. Accelerator-driven experiments, like T2K, use detectors at varying distances to study appearance or disappearance. Reactor neutrino studies focus on anti-electron neutrino disappearance via inverse beta decay.

The Medina City School District's 5.2-mill permanent substitute levy is on the May 8 ballot to replace an expiring operating levy. Supporters, including the parent-run organization Kids First, state the levy is not a new tax and may result in a slight tax bill decrease due to an expiring bond issue. Superintendent Aaron Sable noted the levy would maintain current programs and fund new initiatives, such as reinstating high school French and providing free all-day kindergarten.

The speaker expresses excitement about reaching this point after many years, noting that the feeling of playing remains unchanged since childhood. To prepare, the team is sticking to their normal routine of a morning pre-game skate and stick work to avoid mental exhaustion.

On Feb. 10, APU students attended The GIG, a "La La Land" themed formal dance hosted by the Office of Communiversity at the La Cañada Flintridge Country Club. The event featured two dance floors with different music—a DJ and a live jazz combo—along with activities like cartoon drawing and professional photography.

An Ernakulam court convicted Assam migrant labourer Muhammed Ameerul Islam for the 2016 rape and murder of a Dalit law student in Perumbavoor. While found guilty of murder and rape, he was acquitted of certain charges under the IPC and the SC/ST Act.

This paper addresses the lack of AI policy discussions in computer science curricula despite the growing regulatory landscape in the US and EU. The authors synthesize key developments, noting the US's heterogeneous, non-binding, and politically polarized approach compared to the EU's more structured EU AI Act. To bridge the gap between abstract policy and technical implementation, the authors propose a framework for CS education organized by three perspectives (socio-political, translational, and technical) and three dimensions (scope, power, and agency). This framework uses guiding questions to help students navigate the complexities of translating policy demands into technical specifications.

A penalty kick is a restart where the ball is live once kicked. All attacking players, excluding the kicker and goalkeeper, must be at least 10 yards from the penalty mark, behind the mark, inside the field of play, and outside the penalty area. Players must wait until the ball is touched and moves forward before entering the penalty area. Teammates should be prepared to follow up on rebounds or blocks, while the kicker cannot touch the ball again until another player has touched it. If the goalkeeper secures the ball, the attacking team must transition to defense.

Luca Traini, 28, was arrested after a racially motivated shooting in Macerata, Italy, that injured six African migrants. The attack occurred following the arrest of a Nigerian migrant in connection with the death of an 18-year-old Italian woman. While Northern League leader Matteo Salvini blamed mass immigration for the tensions, Prime Minister Paolo Gentiloni vowed to stop such violence.

Rutgers historian Mark Bray is attempting to relocate his family to Spain following a campaign by far-right influencers and a student petition that resulted in death threats and the doxxing of his home address. Bray, author of a book about antifa, faced increased targeting after a presidential executive order regarding the group. During a recent attempt to flee, Bray reported that his United Airlines reservation was unexpectedly canceled after he had cleared security.

The ADS868xW is a 16-bit SAR ADC featuring an analog front-end with a programmable gain amplifier (PGA), a second-order low-pass filter, and an integrated ADC driver. The device supports internal or external voltage references and utilizes a multiSPI interface for data transfer, including standard SPI and source-synchronous protocols. It includes alarm features for monitoring analog input thresholds and AVDD supply levels. Operational modes include RESET, ACQ, and CONV, with programmable low-power NAP and power-down (PD) modes available to reduce consumption.

Researchers developed a multiscale framework to predict GaN and III-nitride epitaxy growth kinetics by linking atomic-scale interactions to macroscopic behavior. Using molecular dynamics and metadynamics, the study identified a "Ga lubrication" mechanism where ordered liquid Ga layers at the solid-melt interface lower the migration energy barriers for N adatoms. Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations and a diffusion-controlled mathematical model, derived from these atomistic energetics, predicted facet-dependent growth rates. These predictions were validated through MBE growth experiments and TEM analysis, confirming that GaN growth under typical conditions is a diffusion-limited, layer-by-layer process governed by the interfacial free-energy landscape.

On May 20, 2016, Amazon.com, Inc. entered into a credit agreement with Bank of America, N.A. and other lenders, providing an unsecured revolving credit facility with a $3.0 billion borrowing capacity. The three-year agreement replaces a 2014 agreement and allows for potential extensions. Additionally, at the company's May 17, 2016, Annual Meeting of Shareholders, several directors were elected, the appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as independent auditors was ratified, and three shareholder proposals regarding sustainability, human rights, and political contributions were not approved.

USD/JPY dropped over 2.0% following a weak NFP report and the firing of the Bureau of Labor Statistics’ CEO. The Bank of England faces a potential 25 basis-point rate cut to 4.0% amid slowing economic momentum and rising inflation. GBP/USD seeks direction near May's floor, while BTC/USD has declined alongside US equities, testing crucial support levels.
In 2017, Nigerians living abroad sent $21.9 billion home, a 12 percent increase from $19.64 billion in 2016.

On April 7, 2015, NVIDIA Corporation's Compensation Committee adopted the Fiscal Year 2016 Variable Compensation Plan, allowing eligible executive officers to earn cash bonuses based on the achievement of corporate revenue targets.

Sino Gas & Energy Holdings Ltd agreed to a A$530 million takeover offer from U.S. private equity firm Lone Star. Shareholders will receive A$0.25 per share, a 19 percent premium. The board recommended the bid due to risks in China, though some brokers and investors expressed dissatisfaction. Shareholders will vote on the offer in late August or September.

At the National People's Congress, President Xi Jinping stated that China must not be complacent and that only socialism can save it. The meeting, which confirmed Xi's second term and the inclusion of "Xi Jinping Thought" in the constitution, also saw the lifting of presidential term limits. Xi emphasized working for the people's interests, national unity, and thwarting separatist attempts regarding Taiwan.

The treaty of peace, friendship, limits, and settlement between the United States and the Mexican Republic, signed in Guadalupe Hidalgo on February 2, 1848, was ratified and exchanged at Queretaro on May 30. President James K. Polk made the treaty public on July 4, 1848.

The United States paid a gross award of $473,151.26, including $172,962.35 in interest, regarding a claim certified by Secretary of State John Hay on September 1, 1900. Documentation includes registry details for the barque Cape Horn Pigeon of New Bedford, listing its owners, dimensions, and master J. S. Layton, as well as a crew list sworn by master Thomas Scullan.

In 2018, financial markets have faced various concerns, including stock valuations, emerging-market instability, and political turmoil in Italy. While these fluctuations have jarred investors accustomed to central bank-induced calm, the current volatility is less extreme than past crises like the dot-com bubble or the 2012 euro area debt scare. Much of this turbulence stems from the Federal Reserve increasing interest rates. Despite warnings from some investors of an imminent calamity, the U.S. and Chinese banking systems are currently viewed as sources of stability.

At Mobile World Congress, The Graphene Flagship showcased technologies aimed at supporting 5G development. Collaborations have produced graphene-based integrated circuits for low-cost microwave links, a cryogenic cooling pump with no moving parts for base stations, and graphene-based photonics for high-speed data transmission. While manufacturing challenges like yield and material consistency remain, researchers suggest these advancements are moving beyond pure research.

In soccer, the second defender provides individual support by positioning themselves behind and to the inside of the first defender. This "cover" defender must remain goalside and maintain an appropriate distance to react if the first defender is beaten. Because the first defender is facing away, the support defender must use oral communication to announce their arrival and provide instructions, such as "jockey" to delay the attacker or "tackle" when it is safe to challenge for the ball.

The S&P 500 recently declined, with the index falling 2.36% last week and hitting its lowest level since early July. While a Monday rebound is anticipated, market conditions suggest potential consolidation or a deeper correction. Meanwhile, crude oil prices have dropped following OPEC+ production hike announcements and tariff-related uncertainty. Gold prices have risen above $4,000/oz due to economic and political uncertainty.

This study compared Auditory Steady-State Response (ASSR) and Auditory Brainstem Response (ABR) thresholds in 64 infants with normal hearing (NH) or conductive hearing loss (CHL). Results indicated that while AC ASSR thresholds were higher than AC ABR thresholds, both methods showed significantly larger air-bone gaps (ABGs) in the CHL group than the NH group. However, ASSR demonstrated greater threshold variability and less reliability than ABR in differentiating NH from mild CHL. The study concluded that ABR remains the gold standard for infant hearing assessment in EHDI programs, and further research is required before ASSR can be clinically implemented for diagnosing CHL.

Enron's Dabhol Power Company in India has stopped generating electricity after its sole customer, the Maharashtra State Electricity Board (MSEB), ceased purchasing power and moved to cancel their agreement. While MSEB officials claim the plant has shut down, Dabhol representatives state the facility remains operational but lacks dispatch instructions. Enron has expressed a willingness to continue the $3 billion project and engage in discussions, noting that potential tariff adjustments would require concessions from other parties.

Ethereum is trading near $4,450 after rebounding from $4,100, staying within a rising wedge pattern. A break above $4,800 could lead to $5,200, while $4,300 is key support. On-chain data shows $84 million in outflows.

RS Components calculated how long it takes the top five Forbes billionaires to earn various annual salaries. Last year, Jeff Bezos saw the largest wealth increase at $39.2 billion, while Bill Gates saw the lowest at $4 billion. Calculations show that Bezos earns a $100,000 salary in 1 minute and 21 seconds, whereas Gates takes 13 minutes and 6 seconds.
The Committee to Protect Journalists is calling on Russian authorities to investigate threats against Novaya Gazeta following its report on the torture and killing of gay men in Chechnya.

The NVIDIA Turing architecture introduces a Hybrid Rendering model that combines real-time ray tracing and rasterization. Central to this is the RT Core, which accelerates Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH) traversal and ray-triangle intersection testing, offloading these tasks from the Streaming Multiprocessor (SM). The architecture also features Tensor Cores to support NVIDIA NGX, a deep learning-based technology stack that enables AI-driven features such as Deep Learning Super-Sampling (DLSS), InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez. Additionally, Turing introduces Mesh Shading for more flexible geometry processing, Variable Rate Shading (VRS) for optimized shading workloads, Texture Space Shading (TSS), and Multi-View Rendering (MVR) to enhance performance in applications like Virtual Reality.

This document standardizes the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) to enable interoperability between guest operating systems and hypervisors using SEV-ES and SEV-SNP features. The GHCB is a 4 KB decrypted memory area used to manage Non-Automatic Exits (NAE), allowing guests to selectively expose register state to the hypervisor.

Key technical specifications include:
* **Protocol Versions:** Version 2 introduces hypervisor feature advertisement via a bitmap, support for SEV-SNP, and enhanced communication protocols.
* **Communication Mechanisms:** The GHCB MSR protocol facilitates negotiation, including the exchange of the SEV page table encryption bit and protocol versions.
* **SEV-SNP Features:** Support is provided for Restricted Injection (using a doorbell page for #HV exceptions), SNP Guest Requests, AP Creation, and managing multiple VMPL levels.
* **Interrupt and Event Handling:** The specification defines procedures for handling NMIs, SMP booting (including AP Jump Tables), and MMIO access.
* **SEV-TIO:** Support is included for binding trusted PCIe devices to SEV-SNP guests.

This study evaluates strategies for applying Universal Interatomic Potentials (UIPs) to material surfaces, which are often poorly predicted by models trained exclusively on bulk data. Researchers compared three approaches: training from scratch (TS), zero-shot (ZS) use of pre-trained models, and fine-tuning (FT). Using MACE as a foundation model, the study tested unary (gold), binary (ruthenium(IV) oxide), and ternary (bismuth vanadate) systems. Results showed that FT consistently outperformed TS in predictive accuracy and physical realism, even with minimal data. To address "catastrophic forgetting"—where FT loses bulk prediction capabilities—the study investigated multi-head fine-tuning (MHFT). MHFT was found to improve generalizability to out-of-training-domain metal surfaces (Ag, Cu, Pt, Ir) compared to standard FT, effectively maintaining foundational knowledge while enhancing surface-specific accuracy.

The present invention relates to 3-dimensional memory structures organized in arrays of vertical NOR-type memory strings. This lecture discusses effective field theory (EFT) with fine tuning, using two-nucleon EFT as a model. The professor explains that fine tuning occurs when dimensional power counting fails because an operator that appears irrelevant is actually relevant. In the context of non-relativistic nucleons, this requires a power counting that treats the kinetic energy and contact interactions differently than in Heavy Quark Effective Theory (HQET).

Using non-relativistic scattering and the effective range expansion, the professor demonstrates that the large scattering length observed in nature necessitates a new power counting. To account for this, renormalization schemes like offshell momentum subtraction or Power Divergence Subtraction (PDS) are used to track power law divergences. These schemes allow the theory to treat the $C_0$ coupling as a relevant operator, enabling the summation of bubble diagrams to all orders. This approach provides a consistent way to predict the scaling of higher-order operators and explains how fine tuning propagates through the theory via renormalization group equations.

The Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine facilitates moving memory content between different performance tiers to optimize system performance. TMPM requires IOMMU enablement and uses a ring buffer interface for command processing. Commands can migrate up to 128 pages at a time, and status is provided through command and list entry fields.
